1inch is the DeFi ecosystem building financial freedom for everyone. 1inch products help users and builders trade, hold and track digital assets - with the self-custody, comprehensive security and the intuitive user experience they need to unlock the potential of true crypto ownership. 1inch protocols and APIs provide core infrastructure across the DeFi industry and beyond. So if you're someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team.
\n
Your mission
As Data & Analytics Lead, your mission is to turn complex business and product questions into reliable, actionable answers.
You will combine AI, data analytics, data engineering, and deep DeFi expertise to build a more intelligent and scalable approach to decision-making. You will use AI not just to accelerate existing analytics, but to rethink how we explore data, test hypotheses, identify patterns, and make insights accessible across the organization.
You will be highly hands-on, with expert-level Dune capabilities and a strong understanding of DEXes, DEX aggregators, on-chain data, liquidity, routing, and market dynamics.
What you’ll do
Shape and build a self-service data and AI platform that enables teams to ask better questions, find better answers, and make better decisions.
Create intuitive ways for teams to explore trusted data using AI, natural language, dashboards, and other analytical interfaces.
Build AI-enabled workflows and agents that accelerate analysis, uncover insights, and reduce repetitive analytical work, ensuring AI-generated answers are grounded in trusted data, transparent, and verifiable.
Turn complex and ambiguous business and product questions into structured analyses, clear insights, and actionable answers.
Develop metrics and analytical frameworks that connect user behavior, product performance, on-chain activity, market dynamics, and business outcomes.
Proactively identify trends, anomalies, opportunities, and risks, and establish standards for analytical quality, metrics, dashboards, and decision support.
Design and evolve data architecture, models, pipelines, and transformations, integrating on-chain and off-chain data into reliable, scalable, and reusable data products.
Ensure data is accurate, well-structured, documented, discoverable, and accessible to people and AI systems, with strong standards for quality, observability, maintainability, and performance.
Use Dune at an expert level to investigate DEX aggregators, DEXes, swaps, liquidity, routing, users, protocols, and markets, building reusable on-chain datasets and analytical models.
Combine blockchain, product, and business data to create a comprehensive view of users, ecosystem activity, and market dynamics, and continuously explore new data sources and analytical approaches.
Who you are
6+ years of experience across data analytics, analytics engineering, or data engineering, with a track record of solving complex product and business problems with data.
Expert-level Dune skills, with advanced SQL proficiency and demonstrated experience building sophisticated on-chain queries, datasets, dashboards, and analyses.
Deep understanding of DeFi and blockchain data, particularly DEXes and DEX aggregators, including swaps, liquidity, routing, transactions, events, traces, and smart-contract interactions.
Strong AI-native way of working, with advanced hands-on experience using Cursor to accelerate analytics and engineering, automate workflows, and build AI-enabled data solutions.
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, data processing, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.
Hands-on experience building and operating modern data platforms with ClickHouse and Airflow, including data modeling, pipelines, transformations, data quality, and observability.
Proven ability to turn ambiguous business and product questions into structured hypotheses, robust analyses, and clear, actionable answers.
Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to turn recurring business needs into scalable, self-service data and AI capabilities.
Nice to haves
Experience working directly within a DEX, DEX aggregator, DeFi protocol, or other data-intensive Web3 product.
Experience working with raw multi-chain blockchain data, including decoding contracts, events, traces, and transactions.
Experience applying statistical methods, experimentation, forecasting, or anomaly detection to product and business questions.
A strong public track record in the DeFi data ecosystem, such as high-quality Dune dashboards, research, open-source contributions, or community analytics.

****About Anthropic****
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. **About Anthropic**
Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
**About Beneficial Deployments**
Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.
**About the Role**
We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. Our goal is for Claude to close the loop on scientific discovery, and a significant part of this is helping Claude to drive scientific hardware and software. You'll help deploy the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) to labs doing the world’s most important research. You’ll scale what you learn in the field by contributing back to the standard, building scalable assets, and driving associated internal product and research direction.
**Responsibilities**
* Work with labs to automate their experiments end-to-end with Claude - from advising, to prototyping, to writing production code.
* Drive product, engineering and research direction based on field experience - e.g. building evals to measure limitations of our models in the physical world (capabilities and safety), developing new features on MHS, etc.
* Scale your impact to the long tail of labs through reusable cookbooks, documentation, and other assets.
* Be an EMEA ambassador for Claude in the lab - you’ll both inspire and build trust with scientific audiences, from small settings to large conferences.
* This role will require significant travel
**You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* Hands-on experience connecting software to lab robots and instruments (liquid handlers, plate readers, scheduling software, LIMS), ideally in an automated lab.
* Strong engineering skills: you can take an LLM-powered tool from prototype to production code, and write evals to measure its performance.
* A scientist's instinct for how experiments work: you can spot what's worth automating, and where AI might fail or be unsafe in the physical world.
* Experience working directly with external customers or partners in a technical role.
* Clear written and verbal communication: you’ll write docs other labs can use without you and give talks that inspire and earn researchers' trust.
* A scrappy mentality–comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission.
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary: £225,000 — £255,000 GBP ****Logistics****
**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit [anthropic.com/careers](http://anthropic.com/careers) directly for confirmed position openings.
****How we're different****
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
****Come work with us!****
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. Publishing Graduate Program
Our graduate program is a rotation-based journey through our business, based in Dublin, London or Novato, with the possibility of a rotation in one of our international offices. You'll help shape your own experience as we match your learning goals to our business needs.
What is the Publishing Graduate Program?
When people hear ‘publishing,’ they usually think “books”. At 2K, it means everything that happens outside of game development to bring games to market and get them in front of players: advertising, budget planning, marketing technology, live services, growth strategy, player insights and analytics, and go-to-market planning. Our rotations give you hands-on experience across the whole publishing organisation.
Before You Apply...Who are we looking for?
We hire less for a specific degree and more for how you think and work. Across the business, the graduates who thrive tend to be curious, take ownership of their work and think critically about what they're being asked to do, as well as take feedback well. Beyond that, our graduates join us from science, economics, engineering, philosophy, social sciences, arts, and everywhere in between. Our recruitment process is task-based, so you get a real chance to show what you can do. Once you're in, our foundation training and ongoing development mean you're never figuring it out alone.

We keep our process short and straightforward, because we know applying for jobs is stressful enough. What Happens After the Program?
By the end of the program, you'll be ready to specialize and apply for permanent roles across the business, whether that's digital marketing, marketing technology, or analytics. Namibia
Oil & Gas Upstream
ID : 10747
**Project** Venus Ultra-Deepwater Development
**Location** London, United Kingdom - Contractor's Premises
**Contract Type** Residential Assignment
**Start Date** December 2026 (Subject to Final Investment Decision - FID)
**Duration** 1 to 3 Years
**Renewable** Yes
**Reporting Line** SURF Technical Manager
**Travel Requirements** Frequent missions to fabrication yards, supplier facilities and offshore installation sites.
**Role Overview**
The SURF Materials, Welding & NDT Specialist Engineer is responsible for overseeing all technical activities related to material selection, corrosion, welding and Non-Destructive Testing (NDT/NDE) within the Subsea Umbilicals, Risers and Flowlines (SURF) package of the Venus ultra-deepwater development project offshore Namibia.
The position ensures the technical integrity, quality and compliance of materials, welding processes and inspection activities throughout the Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation (EPCI) phases.
The scope includes Steel Lazy Wave Risers (SLWR), rigid flowlines, rigid spools, rigid jumpers and associated subsea structures, incorporating carbon steel, corrosion-resistant alloy (CRA) lined pipes and duplex materials.
The Specialist Engineer acts as the technical reference for the SURF Contractor and its suppliers regarding materials engineering, corrosion management, welding qualification and advanced NDT techniques.
The position also supports the SURF Technical Manager and multidisciplinary project teams, including Subsea Production Systems (SPS), FPSO, umbilical and flexible pipe specialists.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Materials Engineering & Selection**
* Lead and supervise material selection activities for the SURF package.
* Review and approve material specifications, engineering studies and technical documentation.
* Ensure appropriate material selection for ultra-deepwater subsea applications.
* Oversee materials engineering associated with:
+ Steel Lazy Wave Risers (SLWR).
+ Rigid flowlines and rigid spools.
+ Carbon steel (CS) pipelines.
+ Corrosion-resistant alloy (CRA) lined pipes.
+ WOL / MLP / HRB pipe configurations.
+ Duplex rigid jumpers.
+ Associated subsea structures and equipment.
* Verify compliance with applicable project specifications and international standards.
* Review material characteristics, manufacturing requirements and technical acceptance criteria.
* Assess materials and welding consumables used during fabrication.
* Identify potential material-related technical risks and propose mitigation measures.
**Welding Engineering & Qualification**
* Supervise welding engineering activities throughout the SURF EPCI execution phase.
* Review and approve welding procedures and qualification documentation, including:
+ Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS).
+ Welding Procedure Qualification Records (WPQR).
+ Procedure Qualification Tests (PQT).
+ Welding qualification reports.
* Verify compliance with applicable welding standards and project requirements.
* Review welding methods and acceptance criteria.
* Support welding procedure qualification and mechanical testing activities.
* Witness welding operations and welding operator qualification activities when required.
* Assess welding equipment, fabrication environments and associated HSE arrangements.
* Identify welding-related non-conformities and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure welding processes meet technical, quality and operational requirements.
**Non-Destructive Testing (NDT/NDE)**
* Oversee NDT/NDE activities associated with SURF fabrication and installation.
* Review and approve NDT procedures, inspection methodologies and acceptance criteria.
* Provide technical expertise in advanced inspection techniques, including:
+ Automated Ultrasonic Testing (AUT).
+ Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT).
+ Time of Flight Diffraction (TOFD).
+ Inverse Wavefield Extrapolation (IWEX).
* Assess NDT techniques and the qualifications of NDT personnel.
* Review inspection results and technical reports.
* Support qualification and validation of NDT systems.
* Participate in NDT qualification trials and laboratory testing.
* Ensure NDT activities comply with project specifications and applicable standards.
* Support resolution of inspection-related technical issues and non-conformities.
**Corrosion Engineering & Material Integrity**
* Supervise corrosion-related engineering activities within the SURF package.
* Review corrosion-related specifications and technical documentation.
* Ensure material selection is compatible with project corrosion requirements.
* Assess corrosion risks associated with subsea pipelines, risers and jumpers.
* Review corrosion-related technical deviations and derogation requests.
* Support the technical evaluation of CRA lined pipe systems and associated materials.
* Ensure material integrity requirements are maintained throughout fabrication, installation and operation.
**Special Processes & Manufacturing**
* Review and approve special manufacturing processes, including:
+ Heat Treatment.
+ Induction Bending.
+ Pickling.
+ Passivation.
* Verify compliance with project specifications and relevant international standards.
* Assess manufacturing procedures and technical qualification requirements.
* Monitor Contractor and Supplier implementation of approved processes.
* Identify potential manufacturing deviations and propose corrective actions.
* Support technical resolution of fabrication and manufacturing issues.
**Contractor & Supplier Technical Supervision**
* Act as the technical reference for materials, corrosion, welding and NDT matters.

+ Technical specifications.
+ Engineering studies.
+ Drawings.
+ Manufacturing procedures.
+ Welding and NDT documentation.
+ Technical queries.
+ Deviation and derogation requests.

* Support cost optimization without compromising safety or quality.

+ Procedure Qualification Tests (PQT).
+ Pre-Production Tests (PPT).
+ Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT).
+ Extended Factory Acceptance Tests (EFAT).
+ System Integration Tests (SIT).
* Participate in mechanical and laboratory testing activities.
* Witness critical fabrication and welding qualification operations.
* Verify compliance with approved technical specifications and quality requirements.
* Support Company Representatives during fabrication inspections.
* Monitor the technical integrity of manufactured and tested equipment.
* Ensure timely identification and resolution of non-conformities.

* Review technical deviations encountered during installation.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications and approved procedures.

Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure. You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. To fix the biggest problem in healthcare: there are not enough doctors, and the system can no longer keep up. Millions of patients wait weeks for appointments. The DoctorOS, our emerging clinical platform, is becoming the backbone of modern healthcare delivery. #### **Your Mission: Connect Clinical AI to the Real NHS**
AI is only useful to a doctor if it can see the patient's record and act inside the systems GP practices already run on. In UK primary care those systems are EMIS Web, SystmOne and Docman, and most of them have no modern API that does what we need.
Today we bridge that gap with a mix of RPA bots, workflow automation and FHIR integrations. Bots running inside the NHS network pull worklists, lab results and documents from GP systems and hand them to DoctorOS, which syncs the full clinical record and puts it in front of our doctors. It works, it is live across multiple practices, and it is the part of our stack with the most room to become excellent.
As our Senior Backend Engineer, Clinical Automation, you will own this whole path end to end: the bots that operate clinical systems, the pipelines that move data into our platform, and the backend services that make it reliable, auditable and safe. You will also help shape where it goes next, from low-code RPA towards code-first automation and, as they arrive, official integrations such as IM1.
This is a founding-level role. We have real RPA running in production but no dedicated owner for it. You will be that person.
#### **You Will Own**
**Clinical System Automation (RPA)**
* Own and evolve our automation estate that operates EMIS Web, SystmOne and Docman: report extraction, worklist pulls, document handling and, over time, safe write-back.
* Make bots robust: deterministic, idempotent, observable and easy to recover when a clinical system UI changes or a session drops.
* Decide where low-code RPA (UiPath today) is the right tool and where code-first automation (Python, TypeScript, Playwright or desktop automation frameworks) serves us better, and lead that migration pragmatically.
* Evaluate AI-assisted and computer-use automation with a clear eye: use it where it speeds up building, keep production paths deterministic and audited.
**Backend and Data Pipelines**
* Build and maintain the services that bots hand work to: queues, webhooks, ingestion APIs and sync workers on AWS (Lambda, SQS, S3, EventBridge) and Supabase (PostgreSQL).
* Design for the messy reality of automation: duplicate submissions, retries, partial failures, outages at a single practice, and backlogs that must drain safely.
* Own workflow orchestration (n8n today) and the contract between automation and the platform, so neither side can break the other silently.
* Work with FHIR-based clinical data from GP systems, and help prepare for official GP system integrations as they come online.
**Infrastructure, Connectivity and Security**
* Own the environments bots run in: Windows virtual machines, NHS network (HSCN) connectivity, VPNs, credentials and secrets.
* Lock them down properly: least-privilege access, no public attack surface, audited robot identities, and secrets that rotate without drama.
* Build monitoring and alerting so we know a bot has stopped before a clinician notices missing data.
**Clinical Safety and Compliance**
* Work with our clinical safety team to make sure automation meets NHS expectations: DCB0129/DCB0160, DSPT, data protection and auditability.
* Document how each automation behaves and fails, so clinical risk is understood rather than assumed.

* Partner closely with our doctors, operations team, product and AI engineers to find the manual clinical and admin workflows worth automating next.

# How does this role contribute to our collective success?
You will lead the design, evolution and continued embedding of the Group Operational Risk Framework, helping AXIS identify, govern and manage operational risk in line with Board risk appetite, regulatory expectations and strategic objectives. You will act as the senior authority for operational risk, providing independent oversight, challenge and insight to the Group Chief Risk Officer, senior leadership and the Board Risk Committee. · Own and evolve the Group Operational Risk Framework and operational risk strategy, ensuring alignment with the enterprise risk management framework, business strategy, Board risk appetite and relevant regulatory requirements.
· Set Group-wide priorities for operational risk activity, manage supporting resource and strengthen first-line risk ownership through practical guidance, training, constructive challenge and talent development.
· Provide independent second-line oversight across business units and legal entities, delivering a clear Group-wide perspective on material exposures, control weaknesses, trends and emerging vulnerabilities.
· Define and embed forward-looking approaches for key and emerging operational risks, including cyber, artificial intelligence, third-party and outsourcing risk, technology risk and operational resilience.
· Ensure operational risks and controls are identified, assessed, governed and reported consistently across the Group, including through risk and control assessments, key risk indicators, thematic reviews and deep dives.
· Lead the Group risk event process, ensuring effective escalation, root-cause analysis, action management, lessons learned and trend reporting.
· Chair the quarterly Operational Risk Committee, setting a focused agenda and overseeing presentation materials and reporting that enable informed discussion, constructive challenge and clear decisions.
· Own the Group governance, risk and compliance platform for operational risk, including Riskonnect reporting, data quality, system enhancement priorities and the effective use of risk information.
· Lead the development of operational risk scenario analysis and provide operational risk input into the internal model, Own Risk and Solvency Assessment and wider enterprise risk management activity.

· Experience leading operational risk within a complex, regulated insurance or reinsurance organisation, with the judgement to set strategic direction and prioritise the most material exposures.
· Detailed knowledge of operational risk frameworks, including risk and control assessment, risk appetite, key risk indicators, risk events, scenario analysis, controls and governance reporting.
· Able to provide independent challenge and convert complex risk information into clear implications, choices and recommendations for executive leadership and Board audiences.
· Able to operate across multiple businesses, legal entities and jurisdictions, balancing consistent Group standards with proportionate local application.
· Knowledge of relevant regulatory expectations for operational risk and resilience, with the ability to lead responses to regulatory reviews and maintain credible engagement with regulators.

job_description:
**LEEDS BASED**
**Supervisory Risks Specialists Directorate**
As a directorate of the PRA, the Supervisory Risk Specialists (SRS) provides deep technical expertise and applies judgement in specific risk disciplines in order to identify, analyse and mitigate material risks to the safety and soundness of PRA regulated firms as well as financial stability objectives. SRS also supports the wider Bank through providing risk specialist expertise to a range of functions including policy development and implementation, the Bank's concurrent stress tests, Concurrent Operational Resilience Stress Testing, central counterparty and payments oversight. SRS comprises five divisions:
• Operational Risk & Resilience (ORRD) • Sector Resilience Division (SRD) • Credit, Risk, Analytics, Liquidity and Capital (CRACL) • Investment Banking and Sector Risks (IBSR) • Model Development and Review (MDRD)
**Operational Risk & Resilience Division**
The Operational Risk and Resilience Division (ORRD), part of the SRS Directorate, plays a pivotal role in shaping the PRA’s supervisory approach to operational risk and resilience. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the evolution of ORR policy and practice, influencing both regulatory and financial stability agendas. The work spans system-wide issues and engages with central banks, regulators, and government agencies at both domestic and international levels, giving you an opportunity to shape strategic developments in operational risk and resilience.
**Operational Risk and Capital Intelligence Team**
The Operational Risk and Capital Intelligence team is responsible for developing the tools and insights needed to drive a system-wide view of operational risk management, capital and related emerging trends. These allow ORRD to prioritise what matters most and strengthen the evidence base for capital judgements and how they integrate with the division’s broader risk & resilience toolkit using a combination of quantitative and qualitative assessment methods.
**Job Description**
An opportunity has arisen for a Senior Risk Specialist (Data Scientist) in the Operational Risk and Capital Intelligence team.
**Responsibilities**
* Applies data science and advanced analytics techniques to operational risk and resilience data to support supervisory judgement and decision making.
* Works across the division to identify, curate and exploit internal and external data sources to draw actionable insights relevant to all aspects of operational risk and resilience.
* Develops and maintains analytical tools, data modelling and visualisations that improve insight, comparability and consistency of supervisory assessments.
* Works with experts to frame analytical questions and shape hypotheses that support supervisory priorities to ensure data is used proportionately and effectively in firm assessments and cross-firm analysis.
* Translates complex analytical outputs into clear, decision‐relevant insight for supervisors and senior stakeholders and actively proposes optimal methods for distilling intelligence from relevant data.
* Exercises sound judgement when working with imperfect, incomplete or noisy data, clearly articulating limitations, assumptions and uncertainty.
* Influences how data is used across the division by promoting good practice, common approaches and efficient reuse of analytical assets.
* Owns the delivery of analytical products, contributes to shaping analytical priorities across the division, and influences the adoption of data-driven approaches beyond immediate assignments.
**Requirements**
Minimum Criteria
* Relevant professional experience applying data science, statistical analysis, machine learning or advanced analytical techniques to complex risk, regulatory, policy or business problems.
* Experience developing and maintaining analytical tools, data models, dashboards or visualisations that improve consistency, comparability and decision-making.
* Relevant experience in data modelling, data lifecycle management, sourcing, preparation, modelling, validation, visualisation and communication of results.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured datasets and extracting meaningful insights from imperfect, incomplete or complex data.
* Ability to develop strong partnerships across our pool of subject matter experts to derive key risk indicators.
* Ability to translate technical analytical findings into clear and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to exercise sound judgement when working with uncertainty, assumptions and analytical limitations.
* Experience working collaboratively with subject matter experts to frame analytical questions and support evidence-based decision-making.
Essential Criteria
* A vision for how data science and advanced analytics can strengthen supervisory assessment, risk identification and decision-making across operational risk, IT risk and resilience.
* Ability to apply advanced analytical and data science techniques to identify patterns, emerging risks and actionable insights from a range of internal and external datasets.
* Ability to define analytical approaches, derive metrics that illuminate key business risks and shape hypotheses that address complex supervisory, regulatory or risk management questions.
* Experience influencing the use of data and analytics across teams through the promotion of good practice, common methodologies and scalable analytical solutions to help answer specific operational risk and resilience questions.
* Strong ability to present complex analytical concepts, assumptions, limitations and uncertainty to both technical and senior non-technical audiences in a clear and accessible way, demonstrating their relevance to key business outcomes.
* Experience partnering effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including risk specialists, supervisors and policy experts, to deliver impactful analytical outcomes to help answer key business questions.
* Sound understanding of data quality, governance, model risk and the controls required to support robust analytical decision-making needed to drive key business decisions.
* Experience producing senior-grade analytical outputs, briefings and recommendations that inform strategic decisions, supervisory assessments or organisational priorities.
* Ability to coach, support and influence colleagues, helping to build analytical capability and encourage greater adoption of data-driven approaches.
Desirable Criteria
* Experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence or advanced statistical techniques to risk management, supervisory or regulatory challenges.
* Experience leading cross-functional analytical initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and specialist disciplines with ability to influence analytical thinking and best practice.
* Relevant professional qualifications or advanced academic qualifications in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, operational research or a related discipline.
* Understanding of operational risk, operational resilience, technology risk, cyber risk or operational risk capital frameworks.
* A genuine interest and curiosity in understanding proximity of external risks in relation to the team’s and division’s portfolio of work.
**What will I get from the role?**
* Shape how data science and advanced analytics are used to support specialist supervision of operational risk management.
* Develop innovative analytical tools and approaches that strengthen the PRA's supervisory toolkit and evidence base.
* Undertake stimulating and intellectually challenging work at the intersection of data science, supervision and financial stability.
* Influence supervisory priorities, firm assessments and strategic decision-making through impactful data-driven insights.
* Glean business insights by working alongside leading subject matter experts across operational risk, resilience, cyber risk, third party risk and capital modelling.
* Contribute to the Bank's analytical community and play a role in the evolution of data-driven supervision across the PRA.
**Our Approach to Inclusion**
The Bank values diversity, equity and inclusion. We play a key role in maintaining monetary and financial stability, and to do that effectively, we believe we need a workforce that reflects the society we serve.
At the Bank of England, we want all colleagues to feel valued and respected, so we're working hard to build an inclusive culture which supports people from all backgrounds and communities to be at their best at work. We celebrate all forms of diversity, including (but not limited to) age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation and socioeconomic status. Finally, we're proud to be a member of the Disability Confident Scheme. If you wish to apply under this scheme, you should check the box in the ‘Candidate Personal Information’ under the ‘Disability Confident Scheme’ section of the application.
**Salary and Benefits Information**
We encourage flexible working, part time working and job share arrangements. Part time salary and benefits will be on a pro-rated basis as appropriate.
We offer a salary circa £73,760 - £82,900. In addition, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package as detailed below:
* Currently a non-contributory, career average pension giving you a guaranteed retirement benefit of 1/80th of your annual salary for every year worked. There is the option to increase your pension (to 1/65th) or decrease (to 1/105th) in exchange for salary through our flexible benefits programme each year. The Bank has the discretion to vary standard accrual rates and dial up and dial down rates at any time and to withdraw dial up and dial down options at any time.
* A discretionary performance award based on a current award pool.
* An 8% benefits allowance with the option to take as salary or purchase a wide range of flexible benefits.
* 26 days’ annual leave with option to buy up to 12 additional days through flexible benefits.
* Private medical insurance and income protection.
**National Security Vetting Process**

## Job Description
Location: Leeds and London
**Background**
The Bank of England is a diverse organisation. Its people are committed to public service and dedicated to promoting the good of the people of the United Kingdom by maintaining monetary and financial stability.
The Finance & Performance Directorate plays a critical role in protecting the Bank’s financial position and reputation. It supports the successful delivery of the Bank’s aims and objectives by ensuring that the organisation has an appropriate financial platform for its responsibilities and future challenges.
The Directorate comprises three divisions: Finance Business Partnering, Financial Reporting & Control, and Financial Planning & Analysis.
**Department overview**
This role sits within the Finance Business Partnering Division, which works closely with business areas to provide strategic financial insight, advice and constructive challenge. The team supports business-as-usual and investment activity, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, cost and headcount analysis, and income reporting. Its purpose is to help stakeholders understand financial performance, manage resources effectively and make well-informed decisions.
**Role purpose** The postholder will provide financial support, insight and constructive challenge to one or more assigned business areas, working closely with senior stakeholders to support strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost management and investment activity.
**Key responsibilities**
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, providing clear financial advice, insight and constructive challenge to support effective decision-making.
* Lead financial planning for assigned business areas, including multi-year planning, budgeting and forecasting, ensuring that financial plans align with business strategy.
* Produce timely, accurate and insightful reporting on expenditure, income and headcount, clearly explaining performance against budget and forecast.
* Work with stakeholders to develop robust budgets and forecasts, reviewing and constructively challenging assumptions to ensure that plans are evidence-based and support value for money.
* Identify emerging financial risks, pressures and opportunities, and recommend appropriate action.
* Support business areas in identifying, assessing and delivering sustainable cost savings, efficiencies and value-for-money improvements.
* Provide effective financial oversight and control of business-as-usual, investment and project expenditure.
* Lead or support month-end activities and the preparation and presentation of monthly financial performance information.
* Collaborate with colleagues across Finance to improve financial processes, reporting and ways of working.
* Support wider priorities across the Finance Business Partnering Division and contribute to the development of junior colleagues.
* Lead ad hoc activities, including process optimisation, as required.
**Role requirements**
**Minimum criteria**
* Significant experience in finance business partnering, management accounting, financial planning or a comparable finance role.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and non-financial information and translate it into clear insights and recommendations.
* Ability to build effective relationships, provide constructive challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work to tight deadlines in a fast-paced and changing environment.
**Essential criteria**
* Experience of budgeting, forecasting and management reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex financial matters clearly to non-finance audiences.
* Ability to identify financial risks, pressures and opportunities and recommend proportionate action.
* Strong Excel skills and experience of using Oracle or another finance or ERP system.
* Ability to analyse large and complex datasets, using data-visualisation techniques where appropriate to identify key implications and make clear recommendations.
* Ability to work collaboratively and support priorities across the wider Finance Business Partnering Division.
**Desirable criteria**
* A recognised professional accounting qualification, progress towards a qualification, or relevant equivalent experience.
* Experience of cost management in a business-as-usual, investment or project-finance environment.
* Experience of identifying and delivering efficiencies or sustainable cost savings.
* Experience of data-visualisation or business-intelligence tools.
**Our Approach to Inclusion**
The Bank values diversity, equity and inclusion. We play a key role in maintaining monetary and financial stability, and to do that effectively, we believe we need a workforce that reflects the society we serve.
At the Bank of England, we want all colleagues to feel valued and respected, so we're working hard to build an inclusive culture which supports people from all backgrounds and communities to be at their best at work. We celebrate all forms of diversity, including (but not limited to) age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation and socioeconomic status. We believe that it’s by drawing on different perspectives and experiences that we’ll continue to make the best decisions for the public.
We welcome applications from individuals who work flexibly, including job shares and part time working patterns. We've also partnered with external organisations to support us in making adjustments for candidates and employees in the recruitment process where they're needed.
From 1st October 2026, we expect all our colleagues to spend a minimum of 50% of their working time in the office per month. This is to capitalise on the benefits of working together in person across teams, while maintaining the flexibility offered by home working. Subject to that minimum requirement, individuals and managers should work together to find what works best for them and their team.
Finally, we're proud to be a member of the Disability Confident Scheme. If you wish to apply under this scheme, you should check the box in the ‘Candidate Personal Information’ under the ‘Disability Confident Scheme’ section of the application.
**Salary and Benefits Information**
We encourage flexible working, part time working and job share arrangements. Part time salary and benefits will be on a pro-rated basis as appropriate.
The salary for this role is, Leeds: £46,320 - £52,110 and London: £51,440 - £57,870.
In addition, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package as detailed below:
* Currently a non-contributory, career average pension giving you a guaranteed retirement benefit of 1/80th of your annual salary for every year worked. There is the option to increase your pension (to 1/65th) or decrease (to 1/105th) in exchange for salary through our flexible benefits programme each year. The Bank has the discretion to vary standard accrual rates and dial up and dial down rates at any time and to withdraw dial up and dial down options at any time.

We are looking for a Software Engineer II, backend-oriented, to join our Data Experience squad. This role centers on backend services, APIs, working across data modeling, SQL, event and integration flows, and product-facing workflows. You're building backend and data-informed features that power product experience. You should be comfortable taking a reasonably scoped business or customer problem, breaking it down, surfacing trade-offs, and shipping a reliable solution, and know when to loop in a senior engineer or escalate as scope or risk grows. We're looking for someone who raises their own bar quickly and is building toward needing less direction over time. **What You'll Do**
* Design and build reliable backend services and APIs that power product workflows.
* Work with data models, SQL, and event-driven flows to support product and backend features.
* Work with UI surfaces when needed to deliver end-to-end solutions, without owning frontend architecture.
* Break down well-scoped problems into concrete technical plans, partnering with senior engineers on more ambiguous ones.
* Contribute to production health (monitoring, alerting, logging, debugging, and runbooks) for the systems you build.
* Work with product, design, infrastructure, support, and other engineering teams.
* Improve quality through tests, code review, observability, and simpler designs.
* Use data and production evidence to validate decisions.
* Participate in incident response and troubleshooting when systems don't behave as expected, escalating and collaborating as needed.
**Who You Are**
* You have 3+ years of back-end focused software engineering experience, with solid backend skills in Java, Scala, Kotlin, Go, or a similar language
* Education: Preferred minimum Bachelor's degree in CS, EE, SW, CE, MIS; or equivalent experience
* You have strong SQL and data modeling fundamentals, and you're comfortable using them to inform backend and product decisions
* You have experience building APIs, services, and integrations, and are developing comfort with distributed systems, event-driven flows, caching, retries, rate limits, and the many ways production systems fail
* You can work across layers of a system, including UI/front-end work when a problem calls for it, but your primary strength and focus is backend
* You write automated tests, review code thoughtfully, and use logs, metrics, dashboards, and tracing to understand how your systems behave in production
* You stay calm and clear during incidents, and you can explain your own trade-offs to both engineers and non-engineers
* You have a bias toward simple, reliable solutions and write code that other engineers can follow and maintain
* You take ownership of your outcomes, not just tickets. You ask what problem you're solving before jumping to implementation, validate risky assumptions early, and escalate when risk or scope is unclear
* You don't take shortcuts around process, security, or production safety
* Nice to have: React/TypeScript or similar frontend experience, merchant- or customer-facing product work, third-party integrations (OAuth, account linking, external APIs), Redis/caching/queues at scale, or experience with analytics and event data products

## Description
📆 **9 month fixed-term contract starting ASAP**
**🤝 Reports to Finance Director**
📍 **London (in office 3 days/ week)**
Globally, 80% of workers don’t have a desk or an office. These workers are the backbone of the global economy, the people we interact with every day in stores, on buses, in our hospitals, delivering our parcels, and maintaining our buildings. The current generation of workplace technology doesn’t fit their needs, Blink enables those people to be productive, informed, and engaged while on the move.
### Why this role exists
Blink is a frontline employee experience and internal comms app. We are VC-backed, around $20m ARR, and we
operate through four entities across the UK, US, Australia, and New Zealand, in four currencies.
That footprint has outgrown the finance team. Between now and next summer we have two group audits, four
sets of statutory accounts, a transfer pricing refresh, a possible new entity due to global expansion, sales tax
obligations in Canada, an R&D claim in the US, and an inter-company loan position to resolve before year end.

run it properly, at pace to ensure we adhere to our reporting timelines.

* Audit and statutory
* Group and APAC audit prep and delivery. (APAC and Group under FRS 102)
* Statutory accounts across the four entities (Aus, NZ, US, UK)
* R&D capitalization methodology that passes audit first time, with support from our finance manager.

* Inter-company loan between the UK and US.
* Transfer pricing refresh covering the Australian tax losses, and the UAE entity if it goes ahead.
* Assistance with entity setup, registration, and tax compliance.
* Canada sales tax position assessment.
* CFC and PFIC status memorandum completion
### Ongoing
* Payroll across the group.
* Month end review and sign-off.
* Covenant reporting
**On the advisory work:** we use great advisors in each jurisdiction and you will have access to them. What we need
is someone who briefs them well, challenges what comes back, and drives it to a conclusion.

Worth being clear, so you can decide quickly.•
* The finance director keeps board reporting, investor and lender relationships, capital and cash strategy, and pricing.

### Essential
* Qualified accountant. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CA, or equivalent.
* You have taken a group audit from prep to sign-off as the preparer, not just supported one.
* Multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation experience.
* Statutory account exposure across US and UK entities. APAC is a bonus.
* Enough international tax exposure to hold your own on transfer pricing, permanent establishment, and sales
* tax. You do not need to be a technical expert. You need to know what to ask.
* Payroll oversight across the US and UK.
* Quick ramp time, no coaching.
* Available to start ASAP
### Helpful
* SaaS or subscription revenue, and comfort with deferred and accrued income at volume.
* R&D capitalisation or R&D claims in the UK .
* Xero, Chargebee, and a modern finance stack. We use AI tools heavily across the team and you will be
* encouraged to.
* You have worked in a company that was growing faster than its processes.
### How we work
We are a small team and a busy one. Four people plus outsourced support, running finance for a group operating
in four countries. That means real ownership and very little bureaucracy, and it also means the work is genuinely
heavy between October and February.
You will report to the finance director and work most closely with our finance manager and finance associate. You
will have direct access to our advisors and our auditors.

You will have the opportunity to be part of something impactful, large-scale, and meaningful. Most importantly, you’ll work for a company with a strong purpose, with an ambitious and supportive team embarking on a journey most start-ups can only dream of!
**Benefits include:**
* Competitive salary
* 25 days annual leave per year (+ public holidays!)
* Additional time off between Christmas and New Year.
* Private healthcare with AXA.
* 3% employer pension contribution when you contribute 5%.
* Cycle to Work scheme.
* Social events (lunches, breakfasts, nights out).
* Enhanced parental leave.

* **Know what's possible, and brief it well.** Understand what the platform can do across segmentation, scenarios, channels, personalisation, recommendations and search, so you can recommend realistic use cases and write a clear brief when a Technical or Business Consultant needs to build them.

## Description
Specialized in civil engineering and engineering structures, Bouygues Travaux Publics is one of the world leaders in the fields of land use planning and sustainable infrastructure construction. Bouygues Travaux Publics is committed to diversity and is open to all talents.
Hinkley Point C (HPC) is one of the UK’s largest and most complex infrastructure projects and will play a major role in the UK’s transition to a low-carbon energy future.
Bouygues Travaux Publics and Laing O’Rourke are working together through the BYLOR joint venture to deliver the main civil engineering works at Hinkley Point C, with a contract value of more than £2.8 billion.
BYLOR is delivering construction on an exceptional scale, combining major civil engineering expertise with innovative construction methods and technology. The project has already achieved significant engineering milestones, including breaking the UK record for the largest continuous concrete pour.
## The Role
We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join the BYLOR team at Hinkley Point C.
Supporting the Quality Manager, you will play an important role in implementing and maintaining the project's quality management arrangements and ensuring that construction activities, documentation and records meet the required standards.
Working closely with construction teams, suppliers and the Client, you will provide practical quality support throughout delivery – from Inspection & Test Plans and quality records through to non-conformance management, continuous improvement and final handover.
## Key Responsibilities
### Quality Management & Assurance
* Support the implementation of the BYLOR Quality Management System across project teams and suppliers.
* Communicate and cascade project quality requirements, including plans, procedures, guidance and templates.
* Provide practical quality guidance and support to construction and delivery teams.
* Develop and deliver quality briefings and training materials where required.
* Promote project management policies, quality objectives and key performance indicators.
### Quality Documentation & Records
* Provide guidance and review quality deliverables including Quality Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), quality records and record templates.
* Review and approve quality records forming part of the project's Lifetime Quality Records for Client acceptance.
* Ensure records provide appropriate traceability and evidence of completed works.
* Support teams in maintaining complete, accurate and compliant quality documentation throughout construction.
### Non-Conformance & Continuous Improvement
* Support the effective management of non-conformances (NCRs) relating to products, materials and construction processes.
* Ensure causes are appropriately identified and that corrections and corrective actions are defined, implemented and closed out.
* Intervene where the quality of works is at risk or has been adversely affected.
* Escalate significant quality issues to senior management where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities for improvement and support teams in implementing agreed actions.
* Monitor quality outputs and KPIs to identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.
### Handover & Completion
* Support and track the handover process as rooms, areas and buildings approach completion.
* Ensure the required quality records are complete and available to support handover.
* Work with project teams to identify and close outstanding quality-related works and documentation.
* Support the progressive completion and acceptance of project records by the Client.
## Essential Skills & Experience
* Previous experience within a Quality Engineer, Quality Assurance, Quality Control or similar construction/engineering role.
* Experience working within a construction, civil engineering or infrastructure environment.
* Understanding of quality management processes and construction quality documentation.
* Experience working with Inspection & Test Plans, quality records and/or non-conformance processes.
* Strong attention to detail and an understanding of the importance of traceability and accurate record keeping.
* Ability to communicate effectively at all levels, including with construction teams, suppliers and Client organisations.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to follow established processes while taking a proactive approach to resolving quality issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good computer literacy, including Microsoft Office.
## Desirable Skills & Experience
* Previous experience on a major infrastructure, civil engineering, energy or nuclear project.
* Knowledge of ISO 9001 and Quality Management Systems.
* Experience managing or supporting NCRs and corrective actions.
* Experience producing or reviewing Inspection & Test Plans.
* Experience with Lifetime Quality Records, handover documentation or completion processes.
* Experience working with complex supply chains, subcontractors and suppliers.
* Membership of, or progress towards membership of, a relevant professional quality or engineering body.
## Location
The role will be predominantly site-based at Hinkley Point C in Somerset, with visits to external facilities and suppliers where required.

This is an opportunity to develop your Quality career on one of Europe's most significant infrastructure and nuclear construction programmes, gaining exposure to complex civil engineering works and some of the highest standards of quality assurance and traceability within the construction industry.

# Transfer to British Transport Police as a Special Constable
**Bring your policing experience to a national force and help us protect every journey.**
As a Transferee Special Constable with British Transport Police (BTP), you’ll use the skills and experience you have already developed to support frontline policing across Britain’s rail network.
You could be responding to incidents, providing reassurance at stations and on trains, supporting vulnerable people or helping to police major events. It’s a unique and fast-moving environment where no two duties are the same.
Special Constables are volunteer Police Officers with the same powers and uniform as regular Police Officers. You’ll work alongside colleagues to protect the public, prevent crime and help millions of passengers travel safely and confidently.
**Why transfer to BTP?**
* **Make a meaningful difference:** Help keep passengers, railway employees and communities safe.
* **Experience varied policing:** Work in a unique operational environment across stations, trains and the wider rail network.
* **Build on your experience:** Develop your existing policing skills through BTP-specific training, operational duties and continued professional development.
* **Join a national force:**Contribute to policing across the rail network while remaining connected to your chosen posting area.
* **Be a valued member of the team:** Join a force where the contribution of Special Constables is recognised and supported.
**Who can apply?**
This opportunity is open to anyone who is currently serving as a Special Constable with an eligible Home Office police force, or who has served as a Special Constable with an eligible force within the last 12 months.
To be eligible to transfer, you must:
* Have achieved Independent Patrol Status, where applicable in England and WalesHave completed the required first aid training
* Have a sound and current understanding of operational policing
* Not be subject to an ongoing investigation by your current or previous force
* Be able to provide your full training records from your current or previous force
* Meet BTP’s medical, vetting and wider eligibility requirements
**Eligibility checklist**
You will not be eligible to apply if:
* You have been unsuccessful at an interview for a BTP Special Constable, Police Officer or PCSO role within the last three months
* You have failed BTP vetting within the last 24 months
* You have received a custodial sentence, including a suspended sentence
* You have been dismissed from another police force or are currently under investigation
* You do not have the permanent right to live and work in the UK
* You have not lived continuously in the UK for the past three years
* You do not meet BTP’s financial eligibility requirements, including those relating to bankruptcy, County Court Judgments or unmanageable debt arrangements
* You have facial or neck tattoos that are assessed as inappropriate under BTP’s standards
You should also review the **Prohibited Occupations List** before applying to ensure that your employment does not conflict with the role of a Special Constable.
You must provide complete and accurate information throughout the application and vetting process. Any previous involvement with the police, including cautions or convictions, must be declared and will be considered in line with the relevant vetting standards.

# Transfer Pricing Manager
London, England, United Kingdom
## Opportunity
We are looking for a Transfer Pricing Manager to join our Finance and Tax team and support Brunswick’s international operations.
The Transfer Pricing Manager will be responsible for managing and developing Brunswick’s global transfer pricing framework, ensuring that our intercompany arrangements are appropriately designed, documented and implemented across the Group.
Reporting to the Head of International Tax, and working closely with colleagues across Tax, Finance and the wider business, the role will combine technical transfer pricing expertise with hands-on practical implementation. The successful candidate will help Brunswick manage transfer pricing risk, meet its compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions and ensure that policies remain appropriate as the Group evolves.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a key area of international tax within a global professional services organisation and to work with senior stakeholders across Brunswick’s international network.
## About the Role
Your key responsibilities will include:
* Manage Brunswick’s global transfer pricing policies and ensure they remain aligned with the Group’s operating model and relevant international tax requirements.
* Lead the preparation and maintenance of transfer pricing documentation, including Master File, Local Files and supporting analyses.
* Coordinate transfer pricing compliance requirements across Brunswick’s international jurisdictions, working with local Finance teams and external advisers, where appropriate.
* Review and support the implementation of intercompany arrangements, including management and service charges, cost allocations and other cross-border transactions.
* Monitor the financial outcomes of transfer pricing policies and identify where adjustments or further analysis may be required.
* Provide transfer pricing advice in relation to changes in the business, including new entities, changes to operating models and cross-border activities.
* Support responses to transfer pricing enquiries, audits and requests from tax authorities.
* Monitor developments in OECD guidance and relevant local transfer pricing legislation and assess their implications for Brunswick.
* Work with local advisors on developments within non-OECD countries.
* Partner with Finance, Legal and other stakeholders to ensure intercompany agreements, policies and operational processes are appropriately aligned.
* Manage relationships with external transfer pricing advisers and coordinate specialist support where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve transfer pricing processes, controls, data and documentation.
* Support wider international tax projects and Group Tax priorities as required.
* Prepare transfer pricing calculations across the Group in accordance with the Group’s transfer pricing policies. Manage and take ownership of the associated invoicing process, from calculation through to the accurate recording of invoices.
* Work with local finance managers in jurisdictions outside the OECD framework to review transfer pricing calculations and ensure they are appropriately applied.
* Prepare supporting calculations and analysis for the Group’s management charge for both statutory and management accounting purposes, ensuring consistency with the Group’s transfer pricing policies.
* Work with local finance managers to prepare transfer pricing sales and purchase estimates to support the Group’s financial forecasting and planning processes.
## What We’re Looking For
Ideally, you’ll bring:
* At least 4 years transfer pricing experience gained within a multinational organisation, professional services firm or a combination of both.
* Strong knowledge of OECD transfer pricing principles and international transfer pricing requirements.
* Experience preparing and reviewing Master File and Local File documentation and supporting benchmarking or economic analyses.
* Experience working with intercompany service arrangements and cost allocation methodologies.
* An understanding of transfer pricing controversy, audit and risk management.
* A relevant professional qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CTA or an equivalent international qualification, would be advantageous.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial information and data.
* Strong IT and excel skills, with a problem-solving mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear, practical advice.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to work collaboratively with senior colleagues across functions and geographies.
* Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive and pragmatic approach, with an interest in improving processes and ways of working.
## Why Join Us
Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.
# About Brunswick
Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes.
Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.
Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. ## **Powering Great Work**
We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. 🔧 **Trades** spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 **Homeowners** get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 **We** get to build products that change homes and lives across the country
As our **GTM Talent Partner**, you'll own hiring across a broad commercial area of Checkatrade, partnering closely with our leaders to find the people who'll help us get there.
We're a lean, hands-on Talent team, so this is much bigger than picking up reqs. You'll properly own your space: understanding the business, challenging what we actually need, using data to influence decisions and making our hiring and processes better as you go.
## **The job, unfiltered:**
* Own end-to-end hiring across our GTM organisation, with a particular focus across Sales, Account Management, Revenue and Commercial Operations.
* Get properly under the skin of the areas you support: how they work, how they make money, what they're trying to achieve and the talent they need to get there.
* Partner with senior commercial leaders, building enough trust to challenge a brief, push back on an unrealistic expectation and bring a point of view rather than simply taking an order.
* Run multiple searches at once without losing pace, quality or candidate experience.
* Build strong passive pipelines and talent pools so we're not starting from zero every time a role lands.
* Use data to understand what's actually happening in your hiring. Think pipeline health, application sources, conversion rates, pass-through, rejection themes and market insight - then use it to recommend what we do differently.
* Use AI and modern tooling to make sourcing, screening, analysis and the wider hiring process smarter and more efficient.
* Keep Ashby useful and accurate. We actually use our hiring data to make decisions, so good ATS hygiene matters.
* Spot things that aren't working and help us fix them. You'll have space to improve processes, test new tools and challenge the way we've always done things.
* Get involved in wider TA projects across data, automation, tooling, employer brand and candidate experience.
* Be part of the wider People team, working closely with People Partners and other teams rather than operating in a TA bubble.
Basically, **you'll hire great people, but you'll also help us build a better Talent function while you're doing it.**
## **The fit:**
The environment you've worked in matters to us. We're particularly keen to meet people who've been **in-house in a fast-paced tech, scale-up or high-growth business**, ideally as part of a lean Talent team where you've had genuine ownership of an area rather than one small part of the process.
You'll ideally bring:
* Strong in-house Talent experience within a fast-moving tech or high-growth environment.
* Solid GTM/commercial hiring experience, particularly across Sales, Account Management, Revenue or Commercial Operations.
* Experience working in a lean TA environment where you've owned hiring end-to-end and contributed beyond your individual reqs.
* Confidence partnering with senior commercial stakeholders who will challenge you and expect you to know your stuff.
* A genuinely data-led approach. You can use hiring metrics, pipeline data and market insight to diagnose a problem, tell a clear story and influence a decision.
* Strong sourcing skills and the confidence to proactively find great passive talent rather than relying on inbound applications.
* Experience managing multiple priorities in an environment where things move quickly and the brief isn't always perfectly formed.
* Curiosity around AI, automation and new recruiting technology, with hands-on experience using tools to make your work better.
* Strong organisation and communication. You keep things moving and don't let the important stuff fall through the cracks.
* A low ego and high standards. You'll challenge when you need to, take feedback well and care about making the whole team better.
*(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)*
## **What you get**
💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme 🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support 🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme 🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme ❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more
## **How this goes**
**Talent chat** → an initial conversation with our Talent team to get to know each other, give you the full context on Checkatrade and understand what you're looking for next.
**1st stage** → a deeper conversation around your GTM hiring experience, stakeholder partnering, how you use data and what you've owned in previous Talent teams.
**2nd stage** → you’ll meet our TA team and People partner to discuss your day to day operating model, and how we work
**Final stage** → meet more of the team and some of the people you'd actually be partnering with. We'll dig into how you think, how you'd approach some real-life Talent challenges here and give you plenty of opportunity to work out whether we're right for you too.

Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.
About the team
Our Sanctions Screening team keeps our merchants and their customers safe. We run and constantly improve the real-time screening that checks payments and customers against sanctions and watchlists. We're scaling it fast as we move into new markets and payment types.
The role
This is an associate-level role for a sharp, hands-on data analyst. You'll help with the day-to-day running and improvement of our screening systems, making them faster, more accurate and more resilient. Sanctions screening, compliance and fincrime experience is a plus, not a must. Strong data analysts from adjacent payments, fintech or similar fields are welcome to apply.
What you'll do
Support the day-to-day running of our screening platform (Fircosoft Continuity, the system that checks payments and customers against watchlists), keeping it healthy and reliable.
Design and test rules that cut false positives and reduce manual case work.
Manage watchlist updates and configurations to stay ahead of regulatory change.
Extend screening to new payment types and build automated testing so improvements stick.
What success looks like
False positives and manual workload fall measurably, without weakening detection.
Screening runs reliably and no longer depends on any single person.
New payment types and controls are supported quickly as the business grows.
What you'll bring
2–3 years' experience in a data analyst or data-focused role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You turn data into decisions.
Hands-on data skills with SQL/BigQuery and/or Python. You don't need to be an expert, but you'll need to be comfortable extracting, compiling, querying data and presenting insights.
Clear communication with technical and non-technical people.
Comfort in a fast-moving, high-performance and high-growth environment.

Experience in sanctions screening, AML, fraud or transaction monitoring.
Experience configuring screening tools and designing screening rules.
Exposure to crypto or other emerging payment types.

* Travel to client office and Circana main office (Bracknell).

* High degree of experience in the application of market measurement data
* Ability to articulate complex technical knowledge of solutions in a simple impactful manner.
* Effective team player and proven ability to work remotely as well as onsite with clients across virtual and diverse teams.

* Demonstrated resilience and sound judgment in dealing with business and corporate challenges and change.

* Administrative accountability: financial and business reporting, adheres to corporate policies, meets deadlines on corporate initiatives surrounding personal development and input into business planning.

## Discover your future at Citi
Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.
## Job Overview
Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution? Then bring your skills in analysis, problem solving and communication to Citi’s Markets Quantitative Analysis team.
By joining Citi, you will become part of a global organisation whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.
**Role Overview**
Markets Quantitative Analysis (MQA) builds innovative solutions to the most complex financial problems facing our trading businesses, control functions and international client base. Central XVA (X-Value Adjustment) is a small team working on important XVA functionality that cuts across asset classes.
**What you will do**
* Create and support analytics for Markets Front Office XVA across multiple asset classes using probability theory, financial mathematics, and numerical techniques.
* Implement these analytics in C++, also using Python.
* Support trading desks.
* Collaborate closely with other MQA teams.
* Work in partnership with control functions to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure.
* Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics.
* Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; and ensure that all team members understand the need to do the same, demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
**What we will need from you**
* This can be an entry level role, although experience in a comparable quantitative modelling role in the financial sector, especially in XVA, is valuable.
* Knowledge of financial products and related quantitative methods, especially Monte Carlo simulation.
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.
* An MSc or PhD degree in a quantitative subject.
* Skill in programming, preferably in C++.
**What we can offer you**
This role provides the opportunity to work in a small team on fast-moving, high-priority projects. You will solve both technical and practical problems, collaborate with other Markets Quantitative Analysis teams, and interact with IT, Risk and Trading stakeholders.
We work hard to have a positive financial and social impact on the communities we serve. In turn, we put our employees first and provide the best-in-class benefits they need to be well, live well and save well.
By joining Citi London, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (reviewed annually), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:
* Generous holiday allowance starting at 27 days plus bank holidays; increasing with tenure.
* A discretional annual performance related bonus
* Private medical insurance packages to suit your personal circumstances.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Pension Plan
* Paid Parental Leave
* Exclusive discounts for employees, family, and friends
* Access to an array of learning and development resources
Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.
