## Description
*This project is one of a number in competition for a studentship from the Faculty of Engineering and Design at the University of Bath. If successful, this studentship is expected to commence 04 October 2027.*
*An alternative start date may be possible if agreed with your intended supervisors and the Doctoral College.*
Artificial Intelligence (AI) currently dominates most modern computing tasks, predominantly through their scaled-up versions deep neural networks (DNNs). Despite the constant improvement in efficiency, the data and power demands of AI are ever growing due to their very fast-paced development. This project focuses on bio-inspired knowledge representation in AI models. For example, we may want to replace an existing face profile in a facial recognition system with a different face profile without retraining the entire model. To do this efficiently, one needs to identify the specific parts of that model representing the information of interest. This challenge is closely related to abstraction and concept learning, which are central to human generalization but remain less explicit and interpretable in most machine learning models [1].
The project will look at models such as spiking neural networks (SNNs) and consider the problems of knowledge representation and localised model editing. SNNs have been considered the third generation of ANNs which, besides being more biologically realistic, are characterised by data sparsity and power efficiency [2]. The ability of today’s hardware to emulate biological neurons is constantly improving [3]. Being able to characterise the representation of knowledge in such networks has a strong impact on efficient AI as well as enabling better hypotheses for knowledge representation in the brain. The project is expected to lead to publications in top AI and Computational Neuroscience conferences and journals.

## **We power people’s progress.**
At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
# **Meet the team!**
As a product team, our goal is to improve the life of our students and our tutors, drive amazing learning outcomes for our learners and enable our tutors to financially thrive through the platform. And we want to do this all while generating business value for Preply so we can help even more people! We strongly believe that we can't achieve business success without our students' and tutors' success.
# **What you’ll be doing:**
* **Own the full product lifecycle for a key area of our platform:** from discovery and definition to delivery and continuous improvement. You’ll be responsible for ensuring each phase delivers value to both our users and the business.
* **Define and evolve the product strategy, and roadmap:** aligning broader business goals, customers, data, and internal stakeholders to set a clear direction and bring teams together to deliver on it.
* **Partner closely with engineering, design, and the business** to build and ship high-impact features. You’ll facilitate collaboration across disciplines, ensuring the right problems are solved with scalable, user-centered solutions.
* **Prioritize initiatives effectively:** making tough trade-offs, clearly articulate the reasoning behind prioritization, and ensure focus on the highest-leverage opportunities.
* **Leverage qualitative and quantitative insights to inform product decisions**: design and interpret experiments, conduct user research, and dig into data to validate hypotheses and identify areas for improvement.
* **Define, track, and communicate product success metrics**: using them to guide learning and continuous iteration, celebrate wins and drive learnings for future product improvements.
* **Act as the internal champion for your product area:** developing deep subject matter expertise and ensuring visibility and understanding of your product’s impact across the company.
* Help shape Preply’s growth by owning product challenges that make a difference for learners, tutors, and our business. Our Growth teams include **LTV Expansion**, focused on helping learners get more value from Preply and keep learning for longer, and **Tutor Content**, focused on helping learners discover and trust the right tutor through richer content and more personalized experiences.
# **What you need to succeed:**
* Experience in Senior Product Management positions, in rapid-growth or evolving environments, where adaptability and focus are key.
* Ability working with data and metrics, using analytical thinking to inform decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Comfortable being hands-on and collaborative, able to contribute directly to product development while also thinking strategically across the product lifecycle.
* A strong sense of empathy for customers, using deep user understanding to inform and shape product direction.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work well across teams and bring people along in the decision-making process.
* An eye for good design and user experience, and a desire to help create products that are not just functional but genuinely delightful to use.
* Curiosity about growth challenges across the learner and tutor journey. Experience in marketplaces, subscription products, or growth experimentation is a plus; no specific industry background is required.
# **Why you’ll love it at Preply:**
* An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
* A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
* A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
* Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
* Access to free mental health support platforms;
* Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
* The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).
## **Our Principles**
* **Care to change the world** - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
* **We do it for learners** - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
* **Keep perfecting** - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
* **Now is the time** - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
* **Disciplined execution** - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
* **Dive deep** - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

job_title: Server CPU Clock Physical Design Engineer, Staff level - Cambridge, UK Cambridge, United Kingdom CPU Engineering
job_description:
**Job Overview**
Qualcomm is seeking an experienced **CPU Clock Physical Design Engineer** to join the **Nuvia Data Center CPU team in Cambridge, UK**. The team is developing next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient custom CPU technology for advanced compute and server-class platforms that will help transform the industry.
In this role, you will help define, implement, and optimize best-in-class clock generation and distribution solutions for high-frequency CPU designs. You will work closely with microarchitecture, RTL design, CAD, circuit design, block-level physical design, and top-level physical design teams to deliver robust, low-skew, low-power clocking solutions for next-generation CPUs.
This is a high-impact technical role for engineers who enjoy solving complex clocking, timing, power, and implementation challenges. You will have the opportunity to influence CPU clocking architecture and methodology from early design planning through physical implementation, signoff, and silicon correlation.
This position is open for **Staff Engineer** level, with scope, ownership, and technical leadership scaled according to experience.
**Key Responsibilities will include**
As a **Server CPU Clock Physical Design Engineer**, you will:
* Define and drive the overall **clock generation and clock distribution methodology** for next-generation data center CPU designs.
* Work with microarchitecture, RTL, CAD, circuit, block-level physical design, and top-level physical design teams to understand, implement, and validate CPU clocking requirements.
* Architect, implement, and optimize low-skew, low-power clock networks using approaches such as **clock H-trees, clock mesh, clock spines clocking methodologies**
* Partner with CAD and physical design teams to develop and deploy clocking techniques that optimize skew, latency, clock power, timing margin, routability, and design convergence.
* Use SPICE simulation and circuit-level analysis to validate clock circuits, clock paths, and electrical behaviour across process, voltage, and temperature conditions.
* Analyse and debug clock-related timing, power, noise, variation, and physical implementation issues across multiple modes, corners, and operating conditions.
* Provide feedback and guidance to block-level and top-level physical design engineers on required clocking fixes, optimization opportunities, and signoff risks.
* Collaborate with PLL, timing, power, CAD, and implementation teams to align clock source assumptions, jitter budgets, clock uncertainty, and signoff methodology.
* Develop, document, and improve clock construction, analysis, and validation flows for future CPU generations.
* For Staff-level candidates, provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional methodology, and drive resolution of critical clocking challenges.
**Required Skills and Experience**
We are looking for candidates with strong experience in **CPU clocking, physical design, timing, and circuit-aware implementation**.
The ideal candidate will have:
* Strong experience in the construction and analysis of **low-skew and low-power clock generation and distribution networks**.
* Hands-on experience with clock distribution structures and methodologies such as Clock H-tree, Clock Mesh, Clock Spines
* Strong understanding of CTS, clock balancing, insertion delay, skew optimization, useful skew, clock power reduction, and clock latency trade-offs.
* Good understanding of device physics, RC delay, signal integrity, variation, and electrical effects that influence clock quality and timing robustness.
* Proficiency in **SPICE simulation and analysis** for circuit design, clock-path validation, and electrical verification.
* Strong understanding of static timing analysis and the interaction between clock architecture, timing closure, jitter, uncertainty, OCV/AOCV/POCV, setup/hold closure, and signoff quality.
* Ability to debug complex clocking issues across implementation, timing, power, noise, variation, and circuit domains.
* Experience working with industry-standard EDA implementation and signoff flows for physical design, timing analysis, power analysis, and physical verification.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with global, cross-functional engineering teams.
**Minimum Qualifications**
Candidates should typically have one of the following:
* Bachelor’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science**, or a related technical field with relevant experience in hardware engineering, CPU design, physical design, clock design, or implementation.
**OR**

What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. ## The role
We’re looking for a Lead Data Engineer to lead a small team of data engineers within our Engineering team. You’ll remain hands-on in designing, building, and operating the data systems behind our compensation benchmarks, customer-facing tools, and AI agents. You’ll take a platform engineering approach to data, building reliable, reusable capabilities that help Engineering, Data Science, and Insights deliver. * Be a senior technical contributor, building and operating the pipelines, integrations, and data services behind Ravio’s product. Design clear interfaces between ingestion, transformation, and downstream applications so teams can build on trusted data without bespoke support for every change.

* Build data quality, governance, and security into everyday delivery through automated checks, clear data ownership, and appropriate access controls.

* Use AI-assisted tools for development, testing, documentation, and investigation. Help the team use them effectively, with appropriate review of outputs and protection of customer data.
### Team management and leadership
* Lead the team’s delivery planning and ways of working, keeping priorities, scope, and dependencies visible. Take part in shared product prioritisation, bringing requests from Data Science, Insights, and Operations into an agreed delivery plan.
* Partner with software engineers, product managers, and data colleagues to make timely decisions and share responsibility for delivered outcomes.
* Line manage and coach a small team of data engineers, providing regular feedback and supporting their technical and career development.
* Build a supportive, accountable team with shared ownership of its systems. Use pairing, code reviews, documentation, and operational handovers to spread knowledge.
## What we’re looking for
* Six-plus years’ experience in data engineering, with at least two years in a team leadership role.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and operating production data systems.
* Experience with data modelling, transformation frameworks such as dbt, and workflow orchestration.
* Experience applying platform engineering principles to data systems, such as reusable ingestion patterns, clear data interfaces, or self-service tooling that other teams use successfully.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD).
* Practical understanding of reliable data processing, including schema changes, retries, safe reprocessing, and backfills.
* Experience using monitoring and data quality checks to investigate failures and improve reliability.
* Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools, with sound judgement about verification, security, and where automation adds value.
* Proven ability to mentor engineers, set team goals, and deliver value for users and the business.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with a bias for action.
* Excellent listening and communication skills.
### How you work
* You speak the language of engineers and data scientists, and are comfortable working with Product, Customer Success, Operations, and founders.
* You bring empathy and strong social and emotional intelligence, with an ability to put yourself in others’ shoes.
* You take satisfaction in solving challenging problems and helping a talented team deliver effectively.
## Our tech stack
### Data Engineering
* Python and SQL
* dbt for data transformations
* dlt for data extraction and loading
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Cloud Functions, Workflows, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Datastream
* PostgreSQL
### Data Science
* Python (polars, pandas, scikit)
* Jupyter notebooks
* SQL and dbt
### Infrastructure and delivery
* GitHub Actions
* Terraform
* Artifact Registry
## Data engineering at Ravio
Data is central to Ravio’s product. As we expand our compensation tools and build AI-powered experiences, we need reliable ways to bring customer data in and make it available across the platform.
You’ll help a small team deliver that work alongside software engineers, data scientists, and product colleagues. Success means useful capabilities reaching customers, dependable data for colleagues, and less time spent on avoidable support and manual processes.
## Why join Ravio?
* Opportunity to be a critical team member in a high-growth startup.
* A blend of hands-on engineering and leadership, giving you both direct impact and career growth.
* Remote-friendly, flexible work culture with a high degree of ownership.
* Work on meaningful problems that help people get paid fairly and competitively in their careers.
## Compensation and benefits
* £100,000 - £120,000 salary
* Company ownership (everyone gets a meaningful equity stake in Ravio)

* Personal worldwide travel insurance - just in case

The world is moving away from rigid ownership models in favour of more flexible, affordable access. Yet the $1.5 trillion device market has barely moved.

### What We've Built
Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value.
We have over $100m ARR, we’re profitable, growing fast, with over a quarter of a million subscriptions across consumers and small businesses. Customers trust us too, with a 4.5/5 Trustpilot rating from more than 20,000 reviews.
For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale.
Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value.

AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade.

* Use AI tools (Claude, BigQuery, SQL) to build automation that removes manual effort from performance tracking and reporting
* Identify and act on emerging delivery risks - delays, lost-in-transit spikes, SLA slippage - before they hit customer experience
* Hold partners accountable to SLA targets, building a clear escalation and resolution process for underperformance
* Support or co-lead cross-functional projects such as onboarding a new courier/3PL partner or scaling the network to support range growth
* Partner closely with Operations, Risk and Finance and build relationships with external partner contacts

* ****Analytical mindset**** with proficiency using Microsoft Office, especially ****Excel****, to support decision - making.

* Good working knowledge of AWS networking — VPCs, subnets, security groups, routing, and load balancing.
* Experience operating relational databases on RDS and/or Aurora.

* Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Terragrunt.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions.
* Strong scripting ability in at least one language (Bash, Python, or Go).
* Good understanding of Linux systems administration and networking fundamentals.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling.
* Comfortable working with Git and modern version control workflows.
* A genuine commitment to good documentation — able to write clear, concise runbooks and technical docs that others can follow.

Rimac Energy is the energy storage division of Rimac Group, the Croatian technology company behind the world's fastest electric hypercar and industry-leading EV powertrain technology. **The Role**
We're looking for a Battery Intelligence Engineer to own how we understand our cells, from selecting and testing them, to analysing how they perform and age in the field. You'll be a hands-on engineer, just as comfortable with the physical testing of cells as you are when delving into the data.
The role requires knowledge of the technical performance aspects of lithium-ion batteries, from understanding the requirements around selecting appropriate cells for a product, to knowing how to validate our advanced SoC and SoH algorithms on a real system.

Cell Testing & Selection
* Engage with cell suppliers on their latest offerings and future cell roadmaps, shortlisting candidate cells for testing.

Data Analysis

* Tracking selected cells through module and rack build, reviewing the build and test data at each stage to ensure consistent and predictable performance.

Algorithm Validation
* Create test plans to validate our algorithms and models, across embedded, edge, and cloud.

* Lead data generation and analysis, comparing results against model outputs and flagging where they diverge.

Technical Expertise
* Act as a technical expert on current and future lithium-ion battery technology.
* Consult with stakeholders on the impact of the BESS design on the performance of the cell.

* Engineering or STEM degree (Bachelor's or Master's), or equivalent experience.
* Strong knowledge of lithium-ion cell behaviour, including performance, safety and ageing.
* Hands-on battery testing experience, including test equipment and data acquisition.

* Experience working directly with cell suppliers on cell selection.
* Exposure to module or rack build and integration.
* Knowledge of battery safety standards and regulations.

multi-brand business that serves millions of customers daily, providing a vast

high-performance products using cutting-edge technology, such as our

our customers. As a Data Architect, you will play a crucial role in designing
and building advanced data solutions and models, working closely with
cross-functional teams to shape innovative products and services. In our
inclusive and agile environment, you will have the freedom to explore,
experiment, and tackle real-world challenges, witnessing the impact of your

play a pivotal role in designing and building leading-edge data solutions and
models. Working closely with colleagues such as Architecture Partners, Product
Owners and the Engineering community, you will ensure the delivery of optimal
data solutions that align with business requirements. Your responsibilities will
include triaging new requirements, assessing their impact, and providing
estimates for modifying data models accordingly. You will also be responsible
for developing and enhancing business physical data models to meet evolving
needs while driving alignment as necessary. Acting as the custodian of data
models, you will define and own modelling within delivery teams, ensuring
adherence to standards and principles. It will be your duty to create solutions
that fulfil business needs and align with the end state architecture, while
simultaneously documenting, communicating, and centrally managing data models in
an appropriate manner. Collaborating with the broader architecture community,
you will share your expertise to promote alignment and innovation across
Sainsbury’s Tech. As an experienced Data Modeller or Architect, you will bring
your passion for creating order within reporting structures, along with a
comprehensive understanding of Data Warehousing/Analytic end-to-end
architecture. Your proficiency with various modelling methodologies, such as
3NF, Dimensional, and Data Vault, will be essential, and your expertise in
staying up to date with industry advancements, including machine learning and
modern algorithmic techniques at scale, will be valuable in driving data design
best practices. Strong communication and influencing skills will enable you to
advocate for and implement these best practises at the Engineering and Product
Manager levels. A curious and driven mindset will empower you to comprehend
business processes and the data they generate, leveraging opportunities to
structure and utilise this data for driving business value.
 
Who you are:
As a Data Architect for our multi-channel, multi-brand business, you are a
skilled and experienced professional who thrives in working with vast and
complex data sets. With a passion for creating order within reporting
structures, you possess expertise in data warehousing, analytic end-to-end
architecture, and various modelling methodologies such as 3NF, Dimensional, and
Data Vault. Your knowledge of the latest industry developments, including
machine learning and modern algorithmic techniques at scale, enables you to
design and build leading-edge data solutions that deliver valuable insights and
enhance the overall customer experience. You've got experience in canonical
modelling, publication service/microservice based schematic design. Your strong
communication and influencing skills, combined with your curiosity and drive to
understand business processes and leverage data for driving business value, make
you a valuable asset in shaping and designing new products and services within
the overall data architecture of our organisation.

* Clear understanding of the differences between Conceptual, Logical, and
Physical data modelling, and able to demonstrate these distinctions.

* Ability to serve as the Architecture custodian for the squad, ensuring
standards and principles are followed.
* Knowledge of Data products.
* Technical expertise in designing ELT pipelines.

# Lead Photonics Design Engineer - III/V Components
Apply for this job
**About us**
Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you'll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.
**The role**
You'll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to lead the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.
**What you'll be doing**
* Lead the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design
* Own the technology roadmap and device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets
* Lead mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits
* Manage fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: define process flows, review process and in-line data, and resolve yield issues as the technology scales
* Define and lead the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups
* Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and drive design iterations to close performance gaps
* Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification
* Mentor engineers and, as the team grows, help recruit and develop new team members
**Essential requirements**
* PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 6+ years' relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 8+ years' relevant experience, including at least 4 years' hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry
* Proven track record of taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including qualification
* Deep understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence
* Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries
* Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation
* Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso
* Proven ability to lead technical projects across design, process, test and packaging functions, and experience mentoring or supervising engineers
* Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation
**Nice to have**
* Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides
* Experience line-managing a technical team
* Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices
* Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices
* Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis
* Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control
* A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

job_description:
# VP, Global Affiliate Marketing & Live Commerce
**About Us** SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. **Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja**, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.
**AI at SharkNinja**
At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.
**Our Culture**
At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.
As part of our team, you’ll embrace a mindset that sets SharkNinja apart:
* Relentless Drive for Edge: Always seeking insights and innovations that give us a unique advantage.
* Insatiable Impatience for Action: Acting boldly and iterating quickly to keep momentum alive.
* Deep-Seated Confidence: Tackling challenges head-on with trust in your ability to solve them.
* Genuine Belief in the Journey: Committing to SharkNinja’s approach, even when it’s unconventional.
**What You’ll Do**
As VP, Global Affiliate Marketing & Live Commerce, you will lead the global affiliate and live commerce demand engine for Shark and Ninja — an affiliate community and a live commerce operation that together scale toward $1B in attributed demand. You will lead teams across our markets, own the program and the technology beneath it, and set the standard for how affiliate creator-led and live commerce is run at global scale.
**Keep Building the Affiliate Community Others Try to Copy**
Our affiliate community is world-class today. Your job is to keep it there as the space matures and competition for the best affiliates intensifies. Deepen and extend it: sourcing and vetting, seeding and sampling operations, activation-to-first-sale velocity, tiering and progression, and the retention of affiliates who prove they can move product. Build category expertise into the organization so that a creator selling a robot vacuum is briefed differently from one selling an outdoor pizza oven — the demo, the objection, and the buying moment are not the same. Treat commission architecture, incentive design, and content velocity as levers to be modeled and tuned rather than defaults to be inherited.
**Advance the SharkNinja Affiliate Program and the Technology Beneath It**
Take a program that is already producing and sharpen it end to end — tiers, economics, incentives, rules of engagement, and creator experience. Partner with our Product team to specify and build the technology that scales it: creator CRM and discovery, the asset and briefing library, content deployment, link generation and deep linking, cross-platform attribution, payout operations, and the clipping infrastructure that turns a single livestream or hero demo into a high volume of shoppable placements. The measure of success is a program that is difficult to replicate and harder to leave.
**Elevate Our Highest-Performing Affiliates into Long-Term Brand Advocates**
Our top affiliates are already among the most effective advocates the brand has. Evolve how we recognize, develop, and support them — early access to product and roadmap, co-created content and collections, meaningful commercial terms, and genuine standing inside the business — so that the creators driving disproportionate value experience SharkNinja as a long-term partner rather than a transactional channel. Design the tier structure, the benefits, and the progression path that make advancing within our community something creators actively pursue.
**Expand Affiliate Creator-Led Commerce Across Every Channel**
Deepen and expand affiliate creator-led commerce across the channels we operate — TikTok Shop, Meta, YouTube, marketplace creator programs, and our owned ecommerce properties — and move decisively onto new commerce surfaces as they mature. Each carries a distinct attribution model, content standard, commission structure, and amplification toolset. Master them centrally so that creators do not have to: our objective is for creators to spend their time on content and selling, not on resizing assets, managing links, and navigating platform administration. Build toward a state where a single affiliate relationship generates demand across multiple destinations, and where performance signal from one channel improves the others.
**Take Live Commerce to a World-Class Standard**
Lead live commerce globally and raise it from a strong operation to a leading one. Lead the live teams, develop the host bench, and hold agency and MCN partners to a standard of operational excellence that sustains production quality while keeping cost per broadcast hour disciplined. Own show formats, run of show, programming calendar, studio operating model, and tentpole moments — along with the operational detail that determines whether any of it works: inventory alignment to live moments, offer construction, replay and clip monetization, and the transition between live and always-on. Build toward continuous streaming with programming compelling enough to hold an audience that did not arrive intending to shop. Live must sell effectively, represent the brand well, and do both profitably.
**Lead a Global Organization and a Center of Excellence**
Lead the global affiliate organization, including in-region teams embedded against local commercial P&Ls, so that a global standard and local commercial reality reinforce each other rather than compete. Stand up a center of excellence that codifies what works and exports it — playbooks, briefing standards, creative libraries, tooling, training, and talent — so that new markets launch with a running start and mature markets keep compounding. Keep the organization lean enough to redeploy against whatever is working, across in-house teams and agency partners alike.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the global demand generation number for affiliate and live commerce, scaling the engine toward $1B in attributed demand.
* Lead the global affiliate organization, including in-region teams embedded against local commercial P&Ls, and set the operating model, talent bar, and performance standard worldwide.
* Build and steward the global creator community — sourcing, vetting, seeding, activation, tiering, progression, and retention — with clear accountability for activation-to-first-sale velocity and productivity per creator.
* Advance the affiliate program: commission architecture, incentive and bonus design, rules of engagement, and creator experience.
* Partner with Product to specify and build the affiliate technology stack — creator CRM and discovery, asset and briefing library, content deployment, deep linking, cross-platform attribution, payouts, and clipping infrastructure.
* Develop the tier, benefit, and recognition structure that elevates top affiliates into long-term brand advocates and premier business partners.
* Expand and deepen affiliate creator-led commerce across TikTok Shop, Meta, YouTube, marketplace creator programs, and owned ecommerce, and establish presence on new commerce surfaces as they mature.
* Reduce operational friction for creators so their time is spent on content and selling rather than platform administration.
* Lead live commerce globally: host bench, show formats, programming calendar, studio and production operations, agency and MCN performance, and continuous streaming.
* Grow live commerce into a channel with positive contribution margin in every market it runs, while raising the creative standard of what goes on air.
* Align offer, promotion, and inventory with Merchandising, Brand, and Supply Chain so that live and affiliate moments are supported by the right product at the right time.
* Manage cost per attributed transaction, blended return on creator amplification spend, and GMV per live hour as the operation scales.
* Build and lead a global center of excellence that accelerates new market launches and lifts performance in existing markets.
* Partner closely with regional commercial leadership, Brand, Product, Legal, and Finance to align affiliate creator-led and live commerce with in-market commercial priorities and brand standards.
**What You’ll Bring**
We are less interested in years served than in what you have actually built and sold. The strongest candidates will bring a genuinely hybrid background — commerce, merchandising, creator partnerships, marketing, and production — and almost nobody has all five. Tell us which of these you own outright, which you have run alongside, and which you would hire for.
* A track record of building affiliate or creator-led commerce into a material revenue channel — with the GMV, growth, and margin numbers to back it up.
* Real commerce grounding: ecommerce, merchandising, category management, or marketplace operations. You understand assortment, pricing, promotion, inventory, and margin — not just reach and engagement.
* Direct experience building or scaling live commerce — hosts, formats, production, programming calendar, agency or MCN management — with accountability for what the channel actually earned.
* Deep creator fluency: you have recruited, negotiated with, developed, and retained creators at scale, and you understand what makes a creator choose one brand over another.
* Production instinct. You know what makes content watchable and what makes it sell, and you can tell the difference between a beautiful broadcast and a productive one.
* Fluency in the mechanics of at least one major commerce platform — attribution models, commission structures, creator tooling, and paid amplification — and the appetite to learn the rest quickly.
* Experience partnering with Product or engineering to specify and build marketing and commerce technology from the ground up.
* Commercial and financial credibility: able to run a channel to a contribution margin target and defend the economics in front of a leadership team.
* Demonstrated ability to build and lead distributed global teams, including leaders embedded in regional markets, and to make a matrixed operating model genuinely work.
* Experience launching brands, products, or channels into new international markets.
* Comfort operating in a space with no settled playbook, where platforms, economics, and rules change frequently.
* Willingness to travel internationally and operate across time zones spanning the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
This is a commerce role. If your background is brand social or influencer marketing measured in reach, impressions, and engagement rather than units, revenue, and margin, this will not be the right fit — and we would rather say so here than discover it together in round three.

# Senior Product Integrity Engineer
**About SharkNinja**
SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company with a diversified portfolio of lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. **About the role**
We are looking for a technically strong, proactive and detail-oriented **Senior Product Integrity Engineer** to join our UK team, with a focus on design assurance, engineering validation and product quality.
Embedded within the New Product Development (NPD) process, you will take ownership of product integrity activities from concept through to production launch, ensuring quality, safety, reliability and consumer expectations are built into the design.
You will partner closely with Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to lead risk assessment and validation activities. You will use engineering judgement, test evidence and consumer insights to challenge designs, resolve risks and influence decisions at critical development milestones.
This role offers broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to directly influence whether our products deliver SharkNinja’s 5-star quality standard.
**Key responsibilities**
**Design assurance and engineering validation**
* Lead product integrity input into design reviews, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), design verification and validation planning (DVP&R), and safety reviews throughout the NPD lifecycle.
* Own the development and delivery of risk-based verification and validation plans, establishing clear test methods, acceptance criteria and evidence requirements aligned with product specifications and applicable UK, European and other target-market requirements.
* Challenge design assumptions and assess product performance, reliability, robustness and foreseeable use conditions, ensuring risks are understood and addressed before tooling and production release.
* Evaluate engineering changes for their impact on quality, safety and performance, defining appropriate revalidation requirements to prevent regression.
* Review and approve quality-related manufacturing and test documentation within your remit, ensuring requirements are clearly translated into production controls.
* Contribute to Design for Manufacture (DFM) reviews, assessing tolerances, process capability and potential sources of manufacturing variation.
* Provide evidence-based recommendations on product readiness, escalating unresolved risks and driving corrective action ahead of development milestones.
**Cross-functional leadership and quality governance**
* Represent product integrity within cross-functional NPD teams, translating consumer expectations and quality requirements into practical engineering decisions.
* Lead quality risk and action reviews, establishing clear ownership, priorities and closure criteria.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers to define process controls, quality gates and production acceptance criteria ahead of mass production.
* Lead technical investigation of issues identified during prototype, pilot and pre-production builds, coordinating root-cause analysis and verifying corrective action effectiveness.
* Challenge supplier 8D investigations and corrective action proposals, ensuring conclusions are supported by robust evidence.
* Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities addressing design and process gaps, tracking actions through to verified closure.
* Provide technical guidance to colleagues and support the development of consistent product integrity practices across programmes.
**Data analysis and continuous improvement**
* Analyse validation results, build data, test failures and relevant field performance insights to identify emerging risks and prioritise improvements.
* Define and monitor quality metrics, validation coverage and acceptance criteria throughout the development cycle.
* Apply lessons from existing products to new designs, strengthening test coverage and preventing repeat failures.
* Improve validation methods and pre-production quality processes, addressing systemic gaps with sustainable solutions.
* Communicate validation status, residual risks and corrective action progress clearly to senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.
**Skills and experience**
**Essential**
* A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Quality Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Substantial relevant engineering experience, typically gained over five or more years, with demonstrated ownership of design verification, validation or product integrity activities.
* Practical experience leading DFMEA, DVP&R, technical design reviews and engineering change assessments.
* A strong understanding of product development lifecycles, design and document control, and verification and validation methodologies.
* Experience translating product requirements and engineering risks into measurable test plans and acceptance criteria.
* Strong technical problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to interpret test data and assess corrective action effectiveness.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, challenge technical decisions constructively and drive issues through to resolution.
* Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence managing multiple programmes and competing priorities in a fast-paced development environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience using data to support engineering decisions.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams, regions and supplier partners.
**Desirable**
* Experience developing consumer appliances, electromechanical products or other high-volume consumer goods.
* Experience working within rapid NPD cycles and supporting products through tooling, pilot builds and production launch.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, accelerated life testing, statistical analysis or Design of Experiments (DOE).
* Familiarity with supplier quality processes, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), process capability assessment and incoming quality controls.
* Understanding of applicable product safety standards and UK and European product compliance requirements.
* Experience incorporating human factors, usability and foreseeable misuse into product validation.
* Experience working with international manufacturing partners and suppliers.
**Travel**
The role may require travel within the UK and internationally to support development builds, manufacturing sites and supplier activities.
**Our Culture**
At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. **Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset** drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.
**What We Offer**
We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. **We empower your personal and professional growth** with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. **When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community.** Together, we won’t just launch products—**we’ll disrupt entire markets.** At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. Going to the beach
💅 Getting their nails done and going on day trips
🎨 Arts, crafts and board games
⚽ Gaming and music

We welcome applicants from all walks of life. What matters most is your attitude, emotional intelligence, and willingness to learn. Ideal candidates will have:
* A strong, compassionate personality
* Emotional resilience and the ability to stay calm under pressure
* Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and sleep-ins
* Problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset
* Life experience from previous careers or personal challenges
* A desire to grow - full training and a funded Level 3 qualification in Residential Childcare provided

* Funded Level 3 Diploma in Residential Childcare
* Structured career progression into senior roles
* £1,400 annual attendance bonus + sleep-in payments (£44.56 per shift)
* 28 days annual leave (increasing with service)
* Free meals during shifts
* Employee benefits including discounts on shopping, cinema, and holidays
* 24/7 well-being support, including free counselling sessions
* Christmas voucher of up to £200, based on length of service and contracted hours, to recognise the 24/7 care you provide year-round

**The Corporate Leverage Team**
Corporate Leverage within Shawbrook refers to non-Private Equity backed transactions in the SME space. We work with both private and publicly-owned corporates, providing cashflow lending solutions to a wide range of scenarios, from general corporate purposes, development/growth finance and acquisitions to full changes in ownership, often supporting clients through various stages of their growth cycle.
As Portfolio Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of Corporate Leverage client accounts — managing them in line with Shawbrook's business model, credit procedures and best practice, and safeguarding the accuracy and integrity of client data and records throughout the relationship.
* *External relationships*: manage senior, board-level client stakeholders and their professional advisers — accountants, auditors and lawyers.

* Act as a responsive, trusted point of contact for clients, supporting their growth plans and resolving day-to-day queries efficiently. * Develop a thorough understanding of clients’ business models, strategies, markets and financial performance. Ensure client information provided, data and practices consistently meet the standards set out in client agreements.
* Collaborate closely with Origination and Transaction Management colleagues to ensure potential opportunities are fully developed and driven forward within Shawbrook risk appetite.
* Review clients’ financial information, including statutory and management accounts, forecasts, budgets, regulatory reporting etc and analyse trends.
* Comply with all client reporting requirements, producing accurate, high-quality reviews/reports as needed to internal risk or Risk/Credit committees and periodic review meetings. Present findings and potential solutions in a clear and concise way to Credit, including Credit Committees as appropriate.

* Proven broader experience within Financial Services.
* Comprehensive understanding of cashflow lending product range and associated procedures.

* Confident using the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), as well as use of AI tools within appropriate guardrails.
* The composure to manage high volumes of work without compromising accuracy, quality or client focus.

* Submit Hot Sauce Group VAT reports
* Prepare and submit ONS returns
* Support tax credit claims and related subsidiary audit requirements

* Help build and improve finance processes and systems as Hot Sauce's in-house finance function matures

* Support development staff with financial queries
* Assist the CEO’s/Managing Director/Creative Director with ad hoc operational and corporate matters

* Experience in production finance or a project-based/media finance environment
* Good working knowledge of UK tax, PAYE, IR35, VAT and accounting standards
* Strong budgeting, cost-tracking and forecasting skills
* Confident communicator, comfortable liaising with producers, founders and a major studio's corporate accounting team
* Self-starter who is organised, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple deadlines and productions
* Proficiency in Excel, Word and PowerPoint; working knowledge of Sage or similar
Desirable
* Direct television/production finance experience
* Experience with production accounting tools (e.g. Just TV or similar)
* Experience with UK funding and tax credit reporting (e.g. NI Screen, HMRC)
* Familiarity with industry contracts, union agreements or freelancer payroll
* Experience working within or alongside a US studio corporate structure

* Belfast-based, with in-office presence expected. Full-time.

# # The Sparta Code
**Understanding is non-negotiable**
***Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.***

**Ask for forgiveness, not for permission**
***Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.***
90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.
**Fall in love with the problem**
***The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.***
Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.
**It's your fault. Lucky you.**
***If it's on you, it's in your control.***
True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.
**Conflict is a gift**
***Honesty is an expression of care.***
Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

### **The role**
This role is central to growing SPM's process optimisation offering in the UK. You'll help customers get more from their processes, not just keep machines healthy. That means improving grinding efficiency in tumbling mills, the performance of vibrating screens, cutting quality in woodchippers, and energy efficiency in centrifugal pumps.
Working with our technical, sales and Remote Diagnostic Centre (RDC) teams, you'll take customers from first assessment through to sustained, measurable improvement. You'll also turn SPM's HD and vibration data into practical operating decisions.

* **Process assessments:** lead on-site studies and baseline measurements of customer processes.
Identify where throughput, energy use, yield or quality can be improved.
* **Application delivery:** specify, install, configure and commission process optimisation solutions.
These include tumbling mill charge and toe monitoring, vibrating screen motion analysis,
woodchipper knife-condition monitoring, and centrifugal pump efficiency monitoring.
* **Data analysis:** use vibration, SPM HD, HD ENV and Condmaster to interpret process and machine data. Build dashboards and recommend changes to operating parameters, such as feed rate, screen set-up and knife change intervals.

experience.

# Product Management - Private Credit, Loan Product Strategy, Charles River Development, AVP
London
Business Strategy and Project Management
R-799361
Full time
Apply Now
**About the role:**
The **AVP of Product Management, Private Markets** is a versatile and entrepreneurial product leader responsible for cross-cutting platform capabilities that serve multiple private markets asset classes — including private equity, private credit, real assets, and multi-strategy funds. This individual owns loan product areas that span the horizontal layers of our platform: data infrastructure, fund analytics, cross-asset reporting, workflow automation, and emerging capabilities such as AI-assisted due diligence and document intelligence. The AVP will operate at the intersection of loan processing and management, investment operations, technology and business strategy, making this an ideal role for a product manager who thrives in a fast-moving, high-complexity environment. Working closely with CRPM Product, technology, operations and data teams, the successful candidate will explore how data from loan management platforms such as WSO, Versana, Siepe and others can be integrated with CRPM, identify opportunities for bi-directional connectivity and translate complex operational requirements into scalable client solutions. The role requires someone who can balance multiple stakeholder needs while getting into the detail of data and workflows, challenging manual processes and defining practical, reusable integration patterns.
**This role requires hybrid work model (at least 4 days in the office per week).**
**Key responsibilities:**
* Define and deliver the roadmap for horizontal platform capabilities supporting private markets loan asset classes, including core data services, cross-fund analytics, workflow automation and API-based integration capabilities.
* Develop a detailed understanding of relevant third-party loan platforms and data structures, including WSO, with particular focus on loan and asset records, security and reference data, income and accruals, positions, reconciliations, cash movements and projected cash flows.
* Assess how loan data can be consumed and utilised within CRPM, identifying opportunities for bi-directional connectivity that improve data quality, operational efficiency and the client experience across both State Street-serviced and client-hosted environments.
* Work hands-on with data to validate mappings, identify gaps and exceptions, and translate business and data concepts into clearly defined product, data and engineering requirements.
* Define and drive the CRPM loan data model and taxonomy, establishing how fund, deal, asset, transaction and investor-level entities relate across the platform and ensuring consistency across workflows, analytics and reporting.
* Identify high-friction and manual loan-processing activities and develop opportunities for automation, straight-through processing and exception-based workflows.
* Drive the development of cross-asset portfolio analytics, including exposure and concentration analysis, diversification, performance attribution and analysis across fund vintages.
* Work with current and potential clients to define standard client analytics and dashboard requirements by combining WSO and other relevant servicing data with accounting ledger, security master, loan reference and transaction-level information.
* Partner across WSO, CRPM Product, Technology, Operations, Architecture and client-facing teams to validate use cases, prioritise opportunities and move solutions from discovery and concept through to delivery.
* Define and own strategic approach to integrations with third-party loan servicing and data providers, establishing reusable integration patterns and a scalable blueprint that can support CRPM's broader private markets strategy.
* Lead agile product delivery, maintaining a prioritised backlog, facilitating appropriate product and agile ceremonies, and working with engineering teams to deliver product increments against agreed outcomes.
* Define product success measures and appropriate reporting to track adoption, data quality, operational efficiency and business impact, using these insights to inform subsequent product priorities.
* Document target-state integration architecture, key data flows, priority use cases, product requirements and recommended roadmap, creating a practical foundation for continued development following the WSO secondment.
* Support the Head of Product and wider Product leadership in strategic planning, OKR development, roadmap prioritisation and cross-functional alignment.
**What we value****:**
**Required skills and qualifications:**
* 5+ years of experience working with loan products within financial services, fintech, or enterprise software — with meaningful exposure to private markets or asset management.
* Solid understanding of private markets operations across multiple loan asset classes, including fund structures, capital deployment workflows, valuation processes, and investor reporting cycles.
* Demonstrated experience owning platform-level or infrastructure product workstreams with technical complexity, with a keen focus on direct loans, syndicated loads, CLOs and various MBS types.

# Composites Manufacturing Inspector
# Job Description – Composites Manufacturing Inspector
The key purpose of the Composites Manufacturing Inspector at SSTL is to provide independent assurance that composite materials, components, sub-assemblies, spacecraft hardware and their associated records conform to SSTL engineering drawings, approved manufacturing processes, programme requirements and applicable customer and space-industry standards before progressing through manufacture, assembly, integration, test or final release.
Working within SSTL’s high-precision spacecraft production environment in the UK, the inspector verifies dimensional and visual quality, composite-process compliance, material and product traceability, workmanship and production documentation; witnesses designated inspection points; and identifies, records and supports the resolution of non-conformances. The role safeguards product integrity, mission reliability and flight safety by preventing incomplete, non-conforming or unverified hardware from entering downstream operations or being presented for customer acceptance.
## Key Responsibilities
· Inspect composite materials, components and spacecraft hardware against SSTL drawings, specifications and acceptance criteria.
· Witness and sign off Key and Mandatory Inspection Points across manufacture, assembly, integration and test.
· Complete inspection and configuration records, ensuring accurate identification and full traceability of flight hardware.
· Raise and control non-conformances, support investigation and disposition, and prevent unverified hardware from progressing.
· Support product acceptance, audits and customer or supplier inspections, working closely with Manufacturing, AIT, Engineering and PA/QA.
· Drive defect prevention and continuous improvement while complying with SSTL, ECSS, programme and UK safety requirements.
· Maintain a clean, organised inspection area in line with housekeeping, FOD and contamination-control requirements.
## Person Specification
### Key Requirements
· ONC/HNC, apprenticeship or equivalent practical qualification in mechanical, production or manufacturing engineering.
· Experience inspecting composite components or other high-precision hardware within an aerospace, space or similarly regulated environment.
· Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances and manufacturing documentation.
· Competence using calibrated dimensional inspection equipment and completing clear, accurate inspection records within a demanding production environment.
· Working knowledge of non-conformance, traceability and quality-management controls.
· Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and effective communication, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

# Head of Product & Product Design
**Who are we?**
Hi, we’re Tails.com – we turn good days into great years for dogs and their humans.
We’re working towards longer lives for millions of healthy, happy dogs by providing tailored nutrition that adapts to each dog’s unique needs. It all starts with a few simple questions about their age, breed, zoomie level and tastebuds. From there, owners can create a personalised meal plan that’s delivered to their door every month. No guesswork, no overwhelm. Just exactly the right care for every dog, every day. It’s pretty clever stuff.
As a certified B Corp, being a responsible business is built into how we work – upholding high social and environmental standards to create better walkies for generations to come.
Now, we’re cooking up big plans. Having created an entirely new category in dog food, we have the backing of Purina – one of the world’s largest pet food companies. You’ll join a bunch of smart people working towards these same goals (and a bunch of very smart office dogs, all working on their own thing).
**Job Title**
Head of Product & Product Design
**Reporting of the role**
Director of Proposition and Product
**Overview of the job**
This is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the product vision, strategy and ways of working across Product Management and Product Design at Tails.com.
In this role, you’ll lead and grow a high-performing team of 5 Product Managers and 4 Product Designers, ensuring we create compelling digital and physical experiences that delight our customers and deliver meaningful commercial impact. You’ll work closely with senior leaders across Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, Data and the wider business to shape priorities, guide investment decisions and ensure products and services are successfully delivered from ideation through launch and beyond.
This role is a blend of strategic leadership and hands-on product stewardship, stretching from shaping company-level strategy to ensuring teams are set up to deliver high-quality outcomes through strong discovery, delivery and continuous improvement.
**3 best things about the job**
* Digital experiences with a physical consequence. Here you get to build digital experiences that have immediate physical consequences. The algorithms and journeys you are in charge of, lead to personalisation that is more than just Markefing fluff, it creates a fully customised meal plan designed to help dogs live longer.
* Shape the direction of the company and the product strategy. Use your knowledge and expertise to feed back up into the business direction and strategy and translate long-term company goals into a concrete product strategy and roadmap, acting as a strong bridge to unite engineering, design, marketing and more around one excellent digital experience.
* Shape how product operates, not just what gets shipped. You’re inheriting a talented team of PMs and Designers, with a good foundation. The opportunity is now upgrading the operating model that gives them a clear craft standard, embedding strong discovery and experimentation habits, and protecting their space to solve real problems.
**Measures of success –** **In the first few months, you would have:**
* Got to know your team inside and out. You know what makes each PM and Designer tick, what’s currently holding them back, and where they need your backing or coaching.
* Built honest relationships across the business. You’ve spent time with Engineering, Customer, Marketing, Data, Ops leads and more, cementing how Product partners with them day to day.
* Wrapped your head around the business model and digital experience. You understand our subscription unit economics, retention levers, and how digital decisions actually affect operations.You know the digital experience well now, and can confidently map opportunities to the right part of the customer journey.
* Led your first quarterly planning cycle. You helped your team turn competing stakeholder priorities and problems to solve into a clear, focused roadmap that is bold and contributes to commercial targets but realistic and ensures smooth running in teams.
* Spotted the friction points in how we work. You’ve identified the first pragmatic improvements to our discovery, experimentation or delivery habits, without trying to rewrite the entire playbook on day one.
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
* People
+ Leading, mentoring, inspiring and developing Product Management and Product Design into a high-performing, outcomes-focused function within the business
+ Setting and embedding best practice across product management and product design, including discovery, test-and-learn approaches, stakeholder communication, customer engagement, analytics and experimentation
* Product
+ Ensuring products and services are successfully delivered end to end, from ideation and discovery through launch, iteration and continuous improvement
+ Building, owning and championing a culture of accountability, with clear ownership of metrics and outcomes, and reporting that meets the needs of different stakeholder groups
+ Owning and evolving the overall product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company strategy and clear articulation of customer and commercial value
+ Contributing to the assessment and prioritisation of strategic and large-scale initiatives, bringing product leadership expertise to shape direction, sequencing and investment decisions
* Process
+ Partnering closely with the Leadership team to build and maintain a product roadmap that balances customer needs, commercial impact, team capacity and long-term strategy
+ Representing product and design to leadership and the business
+ Working in deep partnership with senior leaders across Engineering, Research, Brand, Marketing and other functions to build strong relationships, enable effective decision-making and drive successful delivery
**What you will need:**
Significant experience as a Head of Product, Group Product Manager or Lead Product Manager, with a proven track record of building, leading and developing teams of both PMs and Designers.
Specifically for this Role
* Build trust through transparency and proactive communication, especially with hands-on senior stakeholders
* Strong instincts for organisational design, not just people leadership, including levelling, competencies and future resourcing
* Energised by building structure rather than expecting it to already exist
* Hands-on people leadership. Regular 1:1s, visible career development and proactive check-ins aren't optional extras here, they're core to the role
* Comfortable quantifying the revenue impact of product decisions and holding your own in financial and commercial forums
* Confidence to hold product boundaries with other functions, protecting the team's ability to own problems, not just execute requests
* Experienced leading designers, directly or through a design lead. Holds design to customer and commercial outcomes, and trusts the Design Lead to own craft, quality and how the design team runs day to day.
Classic Product Skills
* Defines and delivers product strategy and roadmaps tied to clear business, customer and commercial outcomes
* Applies product discovery to ambiguous, complex problems and turns them into clear goals and plans
* Influences prioritisation and decision-making at senior levels across the organisation
* Builds experimentation and testing into ways of working, not just intuition-led bets
* Works as a true peer to engineering, not just a requester of delivery
* Deep passion for commercially viable, omnichannel customer experiences
Nice to have
* Experience applying AI to product workflows to improve speed and/or quality
* Experience in D2C subscription businesses
* Experience of running a product department during a digital transformation
**A few of our core benefits:**
* Private Healthcare through AXA
* A 9 day fortnight - our office is closed every other Friday!
* 25 days of Annual Leave and 8 additional remote working days
For more information on our benefits, perks and what makes us unique, please visit our website here
**What’s next?**
If this sounds like it matches your experience and what you’d love to do, we can’t wait to hear from you! If you’re unsure whether you fit our criteria exactly, please get in touch anyway. And because we believe that diverse teams perform better, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.
Here’s a taster of how our recruitment process works:
1. Once you have applied your CV will be reviewed by the Talent Acquisition Team.
2. If selected, you will then have a call with the TA Team who will tell you more about us and the role, as well as learning more about your skills and experience.
3. Should you be successful, the next stage will be a video call with the hiring manager.
4. If successful, you will be invited to present a task back to a panel of interviewers.
5. The final stage is an interview with Leadership.
**Our Commitment**
We’re proud to be an active equal opportunity employer. We want to give everyone a fair chance to join us in changing the world of pet food for good. We do this by conducting a structured recruitment process for all candidates, as well as actively promoting our roles to communities that are under-represented at Tails.com.
During your interview process you’ll meet some of our team with varying levels of responsibility and experience. We want to give every candidate a fair interview process and if you need any reasonable adjustments made, please let us know.

# Senior Engineering Manager (Geotechnical & Geology)
**Senior Engineering Manager (Geotechnical & Geology)**
**Advert Close date: 26th October 2026**
**Purpose of Role:** The Senior Engineering Manager (Geotechnical & Geology) provides technical leadership for geological and geotechnical evidence within the Marine Engineering & Analytics team. The role develops the data, evidence and insights that underpin seabed spatial planning, supporting our efforts to optimise future utilisation of the seabed for offshore wind and other sectors to 2050 through the Marine Delivery Routemap. Through specialist expertise in geology, ground modelling, geotechnical engineering and geohazards, the role translates complex technical information into strategic insight to inform marine spatial planning, leasing and investment decisions. Working within a multidisciplinary team, the role leads engineering workstreams, research and evidence programmes, while engaging senior internal and external stakeholders to ensure engineering evidence supports TCE's business priorities and customer needs.
**Main accountabilities:**
* Lead engineering workstreams and evidence programmes, applying geology and geotechnical engineering expertise to support the Marine Delivery Routemap and wider Marine business priorities
* Act as Technical Authority for the acquisition, interpretation and application of geological, geophysical and geotechnical data and evidence, ensuring the quality and integrity of internally generated and externally commissioned studies, models and datasets
* Lead the development and delivery of TCE's geology and geotechnical data and evidence strategy, including our collaborative research with British Geological Survey and future iterations of our national-scale marine ground model, to meet business and customer needs
* Apply geological and geotechnical evidence to support techno-economic analysis, marine spatial planning, leasing and investment decisions, translating complex technical information into actionable business insight
* Design and deliver engineering research programmes and site investigation strategies, defining data requirements and informing survey business case development, procurement and execution
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with industry, academia, government and research organisations to strengthen TCE's evidence base and thought leadership within the sector
* Engage and influence senior stakeholders internally and externally to align engineering activities with TCE's strategic priorities, customer needs and cross-functional delivery objectives
* Provide mentoring, coaching and technical leadership to support professional development, capability growth and engineering excellence across the team
* Collaborate with senior leaders across Marine to deliver business objectives, foster a positive organisational culture and contribute to wider Engineering & Analytics priorities as required
**Most important skills based requirements:**
* Deep technical expertise in geology, ground modelling, geotechnical engineering and geohazards, with strong experience in data handling, interpretation and the application of geological and geotechnical evidence to support marine spatial planning, site selection, techno-economic analysis and strategic decision-making
* Familiarity with offshore renewable energy project engineering, ideally across multiple areas including substructure technology and structural engineering, with experience specifying, procuring and/or managing marine survey and site investigation programmes
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and report-writing skills, with the ability to translate complex technical data into clear insights and develop evidence, data and digital tools that support business and customer decision-making
* Strong understanding of marine priorities, spatial analysis, multi-sector planning, sustainability and technology developments within the UK marine environment, with the ability to apply sector knowledge to innovative spatial planning strategies
* Proven leadership in technical and engineering environments, with strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage complex workstreams and balance competing priorities across diverse groups
* Chartered status (CEng, CGeol, CSci or equivalent) or actively working towards professional accreditation
* Can demonstrate the behaviours of Better Together, Candour with Care, Resourceful and Accountable which are linked to our values of Together, Caring, Creative and Impactful
**Our Offering / benefits:**
As well as a competitive salary, pension and performance related bonus offering, we have a wealth of benefits available ranging from flexible working; market leading family policies and shopping discounts in the West End, to private healthcare; life and critical illness cover and 28 days holiday with the option to buy more. We value work life balance and your wellbeing highly, enabling you to be your best self to work.
