* **Run customer onboarding**: manage the process, inc working directly with their product, engineering and finance teams. Taking personal responsibility for the early deals. Build the tooling and reporting: onboarding checklists, health dashboards, a weekly CS report to the commercial leadership.
* **Own retention:** build the account health model: payout success and return rates, settlement timing, GMV trends, cost-to-serve, ticket patterns and act on it before customers do.
* **Be the customer's voice** in every incident: failed or delayed payouts, compliance holds, fraud events. Coordinate engineering, payment operations and compliance, and keep the customer informed with precision.
* **Understand and monitor the economics of each account,** including GMV, revenue, take rate, payment/rail costs, FX, support costs and contribution margin**.**
* **Own the commercial plan** for the existing customer base**:** identify opportunities for increased payment volume, additional products, geographies, rails and embedded accounts; quantify the opportunity; and work with BD to convert it. Maintain a rolling expansion forecast across the customer base and provide monthly visibility to the CCO.
* **Provide structured feedback** for product requirements to Product and Engineering: what the platforms need on ledgers, tax reporting, payee experience, age-gating.
### **Scale**
* Hire and lead Customer Success Managers as the order book converts.
* Segment the book (TBC), set coverage models, and run the function against retention, GMV and expansion targets.
## What we need
**Customer first.** You measure yourself by whether the customer's money moved correctly and whether they would recommend us. You are the person who picks up the phone when something breaks, not the one who waits for the ticket.
**Proactive.** You spot the pattern in the data before it becomes churn. You over-communicate internally and externally. Nobody has to ask you for a status update.
**Technically competent.** You can read API documentation, sit in an integration call with a customer's engineers and hold your own, understand how a widget or web view is embedded, and translate a compliance constraint into a product change a PM can act on.
### **What we are looking for:**
* 7–10+ years in payments, fintech, embedded finance or another regulated financial infrastructure business, with significant experience in customer success, implementation, account management or post-sales leadership.
* You have worked in a regulated or highly controlled financial infrastructure environment and understand how KYB, transaction monitoring, funds segregation, sanctions/fraud controls and payment returns affect the customer experience and operating model.
* You have onboarded customers whose end users receive money (many-to-many flows), not just merchants who accept it.
* You have built or materially rebuilt or implemented a CS function - processes, tooling, reporting, team - and can show what changed.
* You are commercially fluent: you understand GMV-based pricing, take rates and cost-plus on rails, and can defend a fee structure to a customer's finance team.
* You have managed enterprise-grade incidents with customers and kept the relationship intact.
### **Additionally we are interested in:**
* Experience with marketplaces, UGC or creator platforms, or gaming.
* Familiarity with tax reporting for payees (1099, DAC7) and cross-border payouts.
* Experience hiring and managing high-performing teams.
## How success is measured
* **Signed-to-live**: customers consistently launched within agreed SLA.
* **Retention**: strong GRR, low preventable churn and clear ownership of customer risks.
* **Customer health**: 100% of live accounts have an up-to-date health assessment, success plan and identified risks.
* **Commercial growth**: increasing GMV and a qualified expansion pipeline across existing accounts.
* **Product adoption**: successful migration of appropriate payouts customers into Embedded Accounts.
* **Operational excellence**: incidents handled quickly, transparently and with clear follow-through.
* **Function building**: playbooks, tooling, reporting and team structure established as the customer base scales.
## About ZBD
ZBD is the embedded money layer for games, pushing the boundaries of how money and games interact to drive engagement, revenue, and loyalty for game studios. Our embedded financial platform powers the full money lifecycle in games: money in, money around, and money out. We handle the compliance and complexity behind the scenes so studios can focus on delivering better player experiences across P2P marketplaces, creator economies, real-money rewards, and esports.
We are a fully remote company with team members across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Everyone here works with a high degree of ownership and independence, and we hire people who thrive in that environment.
This role will shape how the games industry's payment infrastructure is run once it is live. Come build it with us.

### **🌍 Our Vision**
Every child deserves a better start toward the best possible future. The right educator in the right classroom at the right time can change a child’s chances for a better life. Yet too much of our education system’s time, money, and talent are lost to inefficiency.
At Zen Educate, we’re changing that through technology: helping schools save millions in tight times, helping educators find work that rewards their skills and fits their lives, and building a better-educated society that invests its best in every child.
### **👋 Hi, I’m Dan Cohen**
I’m the Chief Product Officer here at Zen Educate. We’ve already helped schools save over £40 million so far. That feels great, but it just shows what’s possible when the system works better, and we have a long way to go.
Now we’re scaling fast in the UK and US, and the next chapter is about building the machine that keeps delivering that outcome at scale. With our Product & Technology team growing very rapidly around the world, we are squarely in the "messy middle." We are moving away from heavy, sprint-based processes toward a high-velocity, **Mission-based** operating model. We need a Product Operations Manager to be the architect of this system.
### **🧭 What “Product Ops” Means Here**
At Zen, “product ops” doesn’t mean creating bureaucracy or being a Jira administrator (especially as we don’t use Jira). It means building the system behind the system. You’ll have read Product Operations by Melissa Perri and understood how a Product-led central-nervous system for our org can drive better PDLC outcomes for our Schools and Educators. You won't be managing the product itself; you'll be product-managing how we build products. We focus on **Missions over Sprints** and **Outcomes over Outputs**. You’ll care more about reducing friction and driving commercial and human impact than about what shape the solution takes.
### **💡 What You’ll Be Doing**
* **Guardian of our Ways of Working:** Own and refine our Mission-based deployment model. You'll ensure teams move from "Pitch" to "Launch" with maximum autonomy and minimum bloat.
* **Manage the "Single Front Door":** Run our weekly Triage sessions. You’ll be the gatekeeper for the business, ensuring all requests are framed as clear Missions with a business case before they reach our Investment Committee.
* **Own the "Single Pane of Glass":** Maintain our central dashboard of core metrics (our HUD). You’ll ensure Product Managers have self-serve access to the data they need to prove their Mission’s impact.
* **Standardize Rituals:** Refine our "Mission Control" and "Waypoints" so the team has a clear rhythm of progress without a calendar full of empty meetings.
* **Operational Glue:** Work closely with Design, Engineering, and Growth to ensure smooth product launches and total cross-functional alignment. You’ll deliver the "Weekly Pulse" to keep the wider company informed.
### **🧩 The kind of person we’re looking for**
* **The Systems Thinker:** You get itchy when there’s too much inefficiency. When you see a problem solved twice, you build a repeatable habit so it never happens a third time.
* **The Pragmatic Mediator:** You can hold multiple perspectives, keep your head when things are moving fast, and help a team find alignment without fuss.
* **The Outcome-Obsessed:** You believe in "buying our commodities and building our differentiators." You want to spend time on what actually moves the needle for schools and teachers.
### **🎓 The Experience We Think Helps**
* **5+ years** in Product Operations, Product Management, or Business Operations scaling systems with measurable impact.
* **Scale-up Experience:** You’ve navigated the "messy middle" of a fast-growing company (Series B/C/D).
* **Data Literacy:** You are comfortable working with BI systems and product analytics to turn raw data into a strategic narrative.
* **Change Management:** You have a track record of optimizing development lifecycles and managing a modern product tech stack.
* **Communication:** Evidence of making complex systems simple and usable for diverse teams.
### **🎁 What You’ll Get**
* Work that directly improves children’s futures.
* Competitive salary and stock options.
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
* A culture that values clarity, pace, and sustainability alongside human kindness.
### **🤝 How We Hire**
We keep it simple:

**About STRABAG UK:**
For over a decade, STRABAG UK has brought the strength and success of the STRABAG Group to the UK. With over 180 years of company history and active in over 2,400 locations across more than 50 countries, the STRABAG Group is a diverse leader in construction, innovation, and financial strength. Located at the former Radlett Aerodrome site in Hertfordshire, SEGRO Logistics Park Radlett will deliver a state-of-the-art rail freight terminal complete with extensive distribution warehouses and over 600 acres of enhanced green space. The development aims to shift freight transportation from road to rail, significantly reducing carbon emissions and road congestion. Construction is anticipated to take place over the next three years. The scheme also promises numerous community and environmental benefits, including biodiversity net gain, employment and training opportunities, and integrated transport improvements.
**Requirements:**
* Implement the STRABAG UK IM Framework on assigned projects under the functional direction of the Head of Information Management, coordinating delivery with project leadership.

* Develop and maintain the Information Management Plan (IMP) and supporting CDE, information control, security, mobilisation and handover procedures.

Ensure the BEP undergoes controlled review and approval.

* Oversee assigned information control and CDE support resources, setting priorities and monitoring performance. Clarify information ownership, checking and approval responsibilities without assuming technical design accountability.

* Maintain information risks, issues and corrective actions; conduct project compliance checks and support central IM assurance, maturity assessments and independent audits with traceable evidence and action closeout.
* Report delivery performance, information quality, outstanding information gaps, compliance and digital adoption to project leadership and the Head of Information Management using consistent measures and validated data.
* Work with reporting and systems teams to enable reliable analytics and controlled automation, reducing duplicate entry and supporting information reuse. Define requirements and verify outputs before operational adoption.
